programme.desc: "Area 51: The CIA's Secret" covers the true story of ground-breaking research into aviation that took place at the Groom Lake Testing Facility, otherwise known as Area 51, which ensured U.S. aerial supremacy from the Cold War through to the present day. Utilizing CIA documents that have recently been declassified this program identifies specific individuals who worked at the top secret base in a variety of roles - the construction workers, pilots and security guards. Their personal testimonies provide a unique impression not just of the work that was carried out, but of the site itself. We reveal just how tight security had to be to keep the development of the U2, A12, HAVE BLUE and F117 Nighthawk aviation programs under wraps. This is a film that concentrates on delivering history and factual accuracy in a fresh and engaging style - one that answers the question of what really happened at Area 51.

programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team rejuvenate three cherished heirlooms that have fallen into disrepair.
First to receive an item in need of attention is our master of metalwork, Dominic Chinea. Nick Cope has brought in a 1950s rocking duck chair that has been enjoyed by countless children in his family. The cheery-looking duck originally belonged to his aunt, who tragically died as a child. His mother was devastated by the loss of her sister and kept the rocking chair as a reminder of her sibling. Nick remembers the fun that he and his brothers had playing in it and would love his grandson to have a go too. However, the duck is in a sorry state and certainly not safe for little ones to ride. Its paint is chipped, and the pale blue upholstery on the seat is too far gone. Dom gets to work on the metal frame while the queen of upholstery, Sonnaz Nooranvary, replaces the seat cushioning.
Braving the evening air with a jacket too delicate to wear is Fiona Elliott. She's hoping Suzie Fletcher's leather skills can save a memento of a brave and much-loved dad whom she called Pops. He was a glider pilot during the Second World War, making several dangerous Channel crossings to deliver troops and equipment to the front line. After the war, the warm jacket continued to serve him well when he worked on his family's farm. Fiona remembers being wrapped in the jacket while out in the fields with Pops. But this job is not for the faint-hearted - the leather is ripped and parched, and the fastenings are failing.
And finally, luthier Julyan Wallis is called upon to mend an old banjo that represents a father and son's love of music. Morgan Du Bruler is very attached to this damaged instrument, which belonged to his late father, who lived a fascinating life, travelling the world with this banjo by his side. It has been passed from father to son for generations, and it was Morgan's turn in 2008 when his father passed away. Morgan also inherited his father's passion for music, and he's keen to continue playing the banjo. However, the years have caught up with the instrument, and it could do with a total refurbishment. Julyan is only too happy to oblige.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Amanda Fisher presents a shattered jewellery box that she is praying Will Kirk can somehow salvage. The 1960s red velvet-lined box was her mother's and gifted to Amanda on her 16th birthday. A toy flying saucer and miniature library of Shakespeare's works are also afforded some much-needed attention. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team welcome the Poet Laureate Simon Armitage into the Repair Shop who brings with him a harmonium, the subject of one of his poems that brings back memories of his late father. Cobbler Dean Westmoreland is given the task of repairing Valerie's pair of children's leather clogs that were bought to help her sister with mobility issues balance in the 1950s. Kirsten Ramsay is tasked with reviving Martin's broken sculpture depicting his mother as a young woman made by a Czechoslovakian art student in 1947. Finally, Kirsty visits jeweller Richard Talman, hoping he can fix her mum's silver charm bracelet gifted to her mother by her father in the early 1960s

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team revive three treasured family heirlooms, resuscitating the precious memories that they hold.
First to arrive, looking for the assistance of goldsmith Richard Talman, is Chris Quinn. He has brought in a precious possession that belonged to his late mother, Esther. The silver shamrock brooch was gifted to Esther by her sisters and represented their family's Irish heritage. Esther was a caring mother to a large brood of nine children, often going without to make ends meet. This pretty brooch was one of the very few nice things she owned. Sadly, Esther died when Chris was a young lad, and he chose to keep the brooch as a reminder of his mum. However, it's now crying out for some TLC. A few years ago, Chris attempted to repair it himself, replacing the missing green precious stones with pieces of green glass, with limited success. To make matters worse, the clasp is also failing. Richard carefully gives the brooch a new lease of life.
Next to arrive is Claire Hardman. She is entrusting her childhood fascination to the care of silversmith Brenton West. The miniature brass replica kitchen was bought for her nana by her father in the 1960s. Nana collected brass ornaments and displayed them all over her home, and Claire and her sister loved playing with the kitchen every time they visited, pretending to cook with its tiny kettles and pots. It was only recently, decades later, that the kitchen was unearthed at her parents' house, and the happy memories came flooding back. It's not as shiny as she remembers, and several pieces are missing, but she's very keen for Brenton to get the kitchen back to its best.
Electronics whizz Mark Stuckey, alongside Dominic Chinea, waits eagerly for the final visitor, Wojciech Witoszynski. He's brought in a distinctive metal desk lamp that belonged to his Polish grandparents, who bought it from a fashionable manufacturer in the 1920s. Wojciech spent wonderful summer holidays with his grandmother and clearly remembers the lamp displayed in her home. Since he inherited it, he's been too fearful to switch it on, not trusting the outdated electrics. Now he hopes the team can bring the lamp and the memories it holds back to life.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team work their magic on three cherished possessions, returning them to delighted owners.
The first visitor of the day is Vicky Oakes. She's brought a mantelpiece clock she'd like horologist Steve Fletcher to take on. Her parents won the gold clock in a ballroom dancing competition. They danced together throughout their long, happy marriage and competed in several amateur dancing championships, winning countless trophies - but this particular clock was always treasured. Vicky lost her father several years ago, and her mother, now in her nineties, suffers from dementia. Vicky believes seeing and hearing the clock ticking again might spark some lovely memories on the dance floor with her childhood sweetheart. The clock has been silent since Vicky was a teenager, and Steve must clean and recondition every part of the mechanism to bring it back to life.
Next to arrive is Iain McPherson with a reminder of a heroic past that will test the mettle of silversmith Brenton West. He's brought a bookend that features a statue of an SAS soldier. It was awarded to Iain's father, who served in the SAS during the Second World War. Although he never spoke of his experiences, he was highly decorated for his bravery. The resin statue has lost its head in an unfortunate accident, and several other sections are chipped, but Brenton is very relieved to discover Iain has kept most of the detached pieces.
The third and final caller at the barn is Alison Ward with her son Alex. Inside their mysterious brown box is a miniature microscope, of a kind optics expert Richard Biggs has never seen before. It was given to Alison's father by her grandfather when he was a boy in the 1930s and has been passed down the family. Alison remembers using it as a child with her father, examining insects and other fascinations. Although small, it was in full working order until recent years. Richard must work extremely delicately and meticulously on the six tiny lenses to clean off decades of dust and grime.

Nuair a tha Pompon a' faireachdainn nach eil sìon a' dol ceart dha, tha Dadaidh a' sealltainn dòigh dha air rudan a chur ceart!
When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hangout with Fox, he fears he's not exciting enough

programme.title: Spongebob
programme.desc:
Spongebob

Sgrùdadh Slàinte | The Check-Up
Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr. Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc:
Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach.
Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Còmhlan
programme.desc: Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a' coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a' trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a' giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a' lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a' dèanamh air Ceann a' Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a' gabhail cuairt a dh'Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a' beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke - forage for nature's bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Faodail: Found
programme.desc: The Faodail Film Archive, which gathers lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, storing the footage for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Summer fishing trips off the Isle of Lewis with Angus Mackay and friends. In Gaelic

programme.title: Seirm | Celtic Connections
programme.desc: Highlights and unseen performances, featuring Mairi McGillivary, Ciaran Ryan and Fara

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Gaelic singer Calum Alex MacMillan joins Cathy Ann MacPhee for music and chat

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo is in Ardkinglas on the banks of Loch Fyne in Argyll. In the House Gardens, he finds out about the model railway that used to run along the lochside. In Gaelic

programme.title: Dàna - Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Coinneach Rankin sets out to find out why the vast mountains of the Cairngorms are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up before they head along one of Tiree's most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree

programme.title: Ceòl Sith
programme.desc: A thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore. Ingrid Henderson presents a tour around Scotland's rich mythical worlds and composes music to bring them back to life. In this documentary, she starts on her home turf in Lochaber where these stories are very much alive, from where she heads to Skye with its traditional fairy stories. She also hears about a terrifying creature in Glasgow - the Gorbals vampire and talks to people in Uist about watery creatures such as mermaids and kelpies. Ingrid creates and performs specially composed music in stunning locations around the country

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame (Rebuilding Notre-Dame)
programme.desc: Built in the 12th Century in the centre of Paris, Notre-Dame was once the world's highest cathedral. This gigantic stone structure is the very essence of Gothic architecture. Today, its stability is compromised as the 2019 fire greatly damaged the building's structure. Its roof was completely destroyed, as well as its incredible wooden frame, made of a thousand oaks, which was swallowed by the flames. Scientists and architects study the impressive skeleton of wood and metal which hid behind the stone. Supported by 3D animations as well as re-enactments, their interventions make it possible to grasp the genesis of this monumental structure

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig.
An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Geam Alainn
programme.desc: Women's football in Scotland, as seen through the eyes of players, fans, pundits and sides including Inverness Caledonian Thistle and the WIIGA team. This documentary reveals some of the extraordinary stories within the game and how it has evolved for the players of today. With contributions from fans Mary Ann Campbell, Seona McClintock and sportswriter Alex O'Henley, Glasgow City FC founders Laura Montgomery and Carol Anne Stewart and SWPL chief Fiona McIntyre. Narrated by Carrie MacNeil

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo and Riz Ahmed. Los Angeles loner Louis Bloom makes a living hustling, until one night he observes a freelance news photographer taking photos of a horrific car accident. Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Supernatural action fantasy based on the Hellblazer comic book, starring Keanu Reeves as troubled Los Angeles exorcist John Constantine. After a young Catholic girl takes her own life, Constantine is approached by her grieving twin sister. As they begin to investigate, they enter a world of the supernatural that sees the pair come face to face with the hidden evil that inhabits the Earth.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: John Carpenter's horror, starring Adrienne Barbeau, Hal Holbrook and Jamie Lee Curtis. Local legend tells of a ship lured on to the rocks of Antonio Bay being enveloped by a supernatural cloud as it sank; the myth says that when this mysterious mist returns, the murdered mariners will rise up to seek vengeance. A hundred years later, the town's late-night DJ broadcasts a fog warning that heralds two nights of terror.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy sequel starring Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones. When evil alien queen Serleena threatens Earth's safety, former intergalactic secret agent Kay holds the secret to her destruction. However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is a rebellious pilot who is accepted into the air combat training programme at Miramar Naval Air Station. programme.title: True North: Derry: A City Spellbound
programme.desc: In Derry-Londonderry, a once divided city comes together for an annual celebration like no other, to share a fascination with ghosts, ghouls and the stuff of nightmares. In 1985, at the height of The Troubles, a Halloween-themed fancy-dress party in a local pub did something remarkable - it united a divided community. Forty years later, the small party that started as a fun distraction has grown into Europe's largest Halloween festival, leaving the entire city spellbound. This programme follows the ordinary people behind the extraordinary spectacle as they create and build the street theatre, costumes and art that bring Derry Halloween to life

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
It's the darkest night of the year, so Love Monster plans on getting cosy in bed. He turns the light off but jumps when he hears a hooting noise from outside. He looks out of the window and chuckles when he sees that it's just Nighty-Night Owl on her bedtime walk. Love Monster looks at the dark room apprehensively and turns on his bedroom light, saying maybe he and Monster Teddy can sleep with the light on. He gets into bed but struggles to fall asleep with the bright light above him.
Love Monster gets out of bed and flicks the switch, trying to race back to his bed before it goes off, but he doesn't make it and freezes in the dark. Just then, the wind picks up, causing his light to move, and there's a knocking sound from outside. Love Monster turns the light back on and nervously looks out of his window to see that it's just the wind knocking a branch against his door. Back in bed, Love Monster soon hears a bump from the attic above his bedroom. He cuddles into his bed, hoping that the noise will go away on its own, but it doesn't. He imagines large monster-like feet stomping in his attic. Eventually he decides to go and look in his attic with Monster Teddy.
Love Monster begins to climb up the stairs with a torch, but when he hears the noise again, he imagines the monster again. He knows that it is more than just wind making the noise but can't fall asleep until he knows what's up there. He pushes the attic door open and looks in with his torch. He sees a huge silhouette on the roof and imagines the monster right there. But then he realises that it is just Monster Teddy's silhouette.
Love Monster ventures further into the attic and some boxes move scaring him. But it's getting late, and he has to find out what it is. He summons up all of his courage and investigates further. He moves the boxes to find... three cute grasshoppers cowering in the corner. They're afraid of the very dark night as well! Love Monster invites them downstairs for a sleepover and makes a little bed out of one of the boxes for them, beatboxing them gently to sleep.

programme.title: Piripenguins

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire?

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he's afraid.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes' quest on Spookyween is to stop whatever is menacing the pumpkin patch, finding out that a headless skeleton is using pumpkins as a head

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them into whatever their costume is.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are excited when they get a job as movie extras. but they end up destroying every take, irritating the director, who has a very short fuse.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Can Joe and Adam scare Traitors stars Freddie Fraser and Jessie Roux?

programme.title: Stage Stars
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show, and Encore - the most senior dancers at the school - warm up for their next big show.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Packed full of amazing celeb guests, epic challenges and lols galore!

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of the most cryptically camouflaged animals of the underwater world. From leopard sharks to the octopus, cuttlefish and a giant moray eel.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost updates on his garden as the growing season ends, and in the Peak District, Rekha Mistry advises on vegetables. Rachel de Thame celebrates chrysanthemums in Nottinghamshire, a mother and daughter discuss Japanese maples, and Advolly Richmond explores Blenheim Palace's garden history

programme.title: Odette
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Anna Neagle and Trevor Howard. Newly widowed Frenchwoman Odette, whose husband was an English soldier, is recruited by intelligence officers to serve as a British agent. After rigorous training, she is sent on a dangerous mission to France.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Setting out to bring in new livestock and expand the range of produce, the chef steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. Marcus heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain creates some family bakes, from daughter Maryam's ultimate jam and chocolate flapjacks, to an easy oven-baked chilli topped with crunchy tortillas, and an epic cookie pie. Nadiya also continues to showcase inspiring bakers from across the UK, this time focusing on Louise Nicholson, whose colourful vegan bakes such as her signature highland cow and unicorn cupcake have taken Edinburgh by storm

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Period romantic drama, based on the novel by Jane Austen. Emma Thompson writes and stars with Kate Winslet in the story of the Dashwood sisters, who are disinherited following the death of their father and find that their reduced circumstances have an adverse effect on their romantic aspirations.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery, where he explores the world-renowned collection of Pre-Raphaelite art. With Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Singer and West End star Sam Ryder, veteran broadcaster Jeff Stelling and Brit Award-winning singer Ella Eyre - each accompanied by a friend or family member - take on the challenge. The line-up is completed by Princess and Junior Andre - the children of Peter Andre and Katie Price - as the four pairs embark on an epic 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. The competitors cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints, before reaching the finish line in Melbourne

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: Second World War epic starring Laurence Olivier, Robert Shaw and Christopher Plummer. In the summer of 1940, Britain awaits the impending German invasion with trepidation. Field Marshal Goering, confident that his war strategy will triumph, orders the Luftwaffe to destroy the RAF. It is left to a brave band of fighter pilots to halt the threat.

programme.title: Live Serie A
programme.desc: AC Milan v Inter Milan (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from the derby at the San Siro. AC Milan defeated their rivals 1-0 in both contests last term, and were also unbeaten in five meetings in all competitions with them in the 2024/25 season. However, it is Inter who are the reigning league champions, and they have also made the stronger start to the current campaign, so they will have high hopes of ending their winless run against the Rossoneri

programme.title: TOTP: Big Hits 1996

programme.title: Oasis - Live at Manchester City Stadium
programme.desc: Homecoming concert from the band's 2005 world tour, following the release of their sixth studio album. programme.desc: Holistic therapist Kara and electrician Jonny are building a striking stone and zinc four-bedroom family home in the rolling hills of West Yorkshire, for themselves and their two young children. The need to build has been motivated by Kara's recent paralysis, caused by a rare autoimmune condition. Their ambition for the house is enormous, as Kara wants to create a home that is not only beautiful but will help her regain some independence. With money tight, Jonny needs to take on a lot of the work himself. As the build progresses, and despite the challenges coming thick and fast, compromise is not an option with both form and function so essential. She enters the historic citadel. And she also learns about the exceptional wool from a special breed of goats that made the Ottomans a small fortune. programme.title: Griff Across the Alps

He begins his journey in France, where he joins a mountain chopper delivery service and gets a close-up view of Mont Blanc. In the valley, he soaks in the ancient thermal waters of Saint-Gervais and catches a rare sighting of the elusive ibex

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: Team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by guests Helen Flanagan, Henning Wehn, Miles Jupp and Alex Brooker to see who best understands what is going on in Britain today. Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent panel show

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Cailee Spaeny and David Jonsson. On the planet LV-410, young Rain, her synthetic "brother" Andy and others attempt to flee their mining colony by stealing useful equipment from a decommissioned space station. Onboard, however, terrifying secrets emerge about the ship's salvage operations and science experiments.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Drama starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson. Following the success of North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock takes the gamble of his career when he decides to make a film version of Robert Bloch's horror story, Psycho. Meanwhile, the relationship with wife and collaborator Alma Reville starts to fray when she embarks on a script with charming writer Whitfield Cook.

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Daisy Ridley. Born in New York in 1905, Trudy Ederle survives childhood illness and goes on to defy societal norms by pursuing her passion for swimming. After achieving success in local competitions, she decides to take on her biggest challenge: swimming across the English Channel.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: Animated fantasy featuring the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos, and songs by Randy Newman. In jazz-age New Orleans, a waitress and a playboy prince seek the help of some quirky creatures as they try to break a witch doctor's spell that has turned them into frogs.

programme.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Kelly Marie Tran and Awkwafina. Chieftain's daughter Raya has been trained to guard five precious gems that protect her community. When she is betrayed by a rival, Raya's people are turned to stone by evil spirits. Alone and desperate, Raya embarks on a quest to find Sisu, the last surviving dragon, who may have the power to undo the spell and reunite Raya with her friends and family.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: Animated musical drama, based on Victor Hugo's classic tale, featuring the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline. Fifteenth-century Paris: when his father is arrested and mother killed, Quasimodo is raised in the solitude of Notre Dame cathedral's bell tower. Hidden from the world by his guardian Claude Frollo, the Minister for Justice, he is taken pity on by a gypsy girl called Esmeralda.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Action adventure sequel starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Jon Voight and Helen Mirren. When a stranger informs them that one of their ancestors might have been involved in the plot to assassinate President Lincoln, treasure hunter Ben Gates and his archaeologist father Patrick set out to clear the family name. Their quest takes them to Buckingham Palace and the White House, where they uncover evidence of a lost city of gold.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: Animated fantasy with the voices of Catherine O'Hara, Martin Short and Charlie Tahan. Unable to accept the death of his pet pooch, young science whizz Victor performs an experiment that brings him back to life. But his secret is soon discovered and it's not long before havoc is wreaked all over town.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A re-imagining of the Sleeping Beauty fairy tale, told from the perspective of its villain, played by Angelina Jolie. When her childhood sweetheart, Stefan, betrays her in order to claim the crown of a neighbouring kingdom, Maleficent the fairy swears she will have revenge. She gets her chance when Stefan has a daughter named Aurora, and Maleficent curses the infant to fall into an eternal sleep on her 16th birthday.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Animated musical drama featuring the voices of Chris Sarandon and Catherine O'Hara. Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King, longs to escape the routine of Halloweentown. Through a door in a tree, he stumbles upon Christmastown where he engineers the kidnapping of Santa Claus and wreaks havoc among the inhabitants.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan and Sean Bean. A school trip to a museum takes an unexpected turn for teenager Percy Jackson when he is revealed to be the son of Greek god Poseidon. He is immediately plunged into a quest to retrieve a lightning bolt belonging to Zeus and prevent a divine war.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: Horror inspired by Mary Shelley's novel, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe. While visiting a circus in London, obsessive scientist Victor Frankenstein rescues a hunchback who is enslaved by the owner, names him Igor and employs him to assist with his experiments into the creation of life. But when Frankenstein's work falls foul of the authorities, Igor must try to pull him back from the brink of madness.

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite

programme.title: Starship Troopers
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Casper Van Dien and Denise Richards. In the distant future, Earth is involved in an intergalactic war with the Bugs, a vicious race of giant arachnids. As the conflict escalates, four high-school friends enlist with the military and embark on a journey that will take them into the heart of enemy territory on the far side of the galaxy.

programme.title: Orphan: First Kill
programme.desc: After escaping from a psychiatric facility in Estonia, diminutive psychopath Esther insinuates her way into an unsuspecting and rich American family to wreak murderous mayhem. Horror prequel, starring Isabelle Fuhrman, Julia Stiles, Rossif Sutherland and Matthew Finlan

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: Fantasy horror starring Liam Neeson and Frances McDormand. When scientist Peyton Westlake is hideously disfigured by a vicious gangster, he plots an ingenious revenge using his invention of synthetic skin.

programme.title: Sink the Bismarck!
programme.desc: Second World War naval drama starring Kenneth More. In 1941, Captain Jonathan Shepard, director of operations at the British Admiralty, begins planning the destruction of Germany's seemingly invincible battleship, the Bismarck. When the vessel moves into the north Atlantic war zone, the success of Shepard's mission becomes imperative.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Gene Tierney as a widow who befriends the mischievous ghost of a sea captain (Rex Harrison) when she moves into the isolated coastal house where he used to live.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: TV-movie version of the classic Charles Dickens tale, starring George C Scott and Nigel Davenport. Ebenezer Scrooge has no time for Christmas and is impervious to the suffering around him. But his attitude is put to the test one Christmas Eve when he is visited by three ghostly spirits.

programme.title: A Knight's Tale
programme.desc: Romantic period adventure starring Heath Ledger. In 14th-century Europe, William, a young commoner, poses as Sir Ulric of Liechtenstein, a knight. But can he change his lowly destiny by winning jousting tournaments, or will the evil Count Adhemar discover the deception before William can win the fair Lady Jocelyn's hand?

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Will Smith. Chicago, 2035: in a society that has become almost entirely dependent on robots, Detective Del Spooner is called upon to investigate the death of eminent scientist Dr Alfred Lanning. All the evidence points to Lanning's superadvanced robot prototype being responsible, but everybody knows that robots are programmed never to harm a human...

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: Horror starring Sophie Wilde. Seventeen-year-old Mia goes to a party where her friends bring out a macabre centrepiece - an embalmed hand that enables the user to speak to the dead. Soon after, Mia experiences visions of her dead mother, and as the visions become more and more disturbing, Mia fears she has let something in that means to do her harm.

programme.title: Barbarian

programme.desc: Over the past seven editions, Jamie Oliver has given some of the nation's favourite dishes a twist, reinventing British classics like shepherd's pie, rustling up outdoor treats and transforming old-school desserts such as pavlova and sticky-toffee pudding. For his final menu, he makes fish and chips with an India Pale Ale batter, a treat for vegetarians with his version of the Indonesian salad gado gado, and a speedy crab linguine

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: The chef visits East Anglia, Lincolnshire and the Midlands. He samples a host of regional specialities including Norfolk black turkeys, Lincolnshire chine, pork pies and Stilton. He then rustles up wild mushrooms and devilled kidneys on toast and an organic leek and lemon thyme cannelloni

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: The celebrated seafood chef visits Smithfield Market, where he challenges the resident butchers to taste the difference between organic beef and off-the-shelf supermarket products

programme.title: Secrets of the Chinese Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Wong reveals the secrets that have made his eatery the first Chinese restaurant outside Asia to be awarded two Michelin stars.

programme.title: Secrets of the Caribbean Kitchen
programme.desc: Award winning chef Keshia Sakarah takes a journey into the heart of Caribbean cooking, uncovering the stories behind the islands' most loved recipes.

programme.title: Secrets of the BBQ Kitchen
programme.desc: Social media star Adam Purnell gives an in-depth look at his unique restaurant, where everything is cooked outdoors over flame, smoke and charcoal.

programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook
programme.desc: The culinary expert offers tips for beginners, showing how to make recipes that will build confidence in the kitchen, including a Victoria sandwich, a mouthwatering stir fry, an open burger, and a biscuit for first-time bakers. In Newcastle, she meets the Men's Pie Club, a group set up to combat male social isolation and the members impress her with their spiced chicken and apricot tagine pie

programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook
programme.desc: Mary cooks four recipes that prove watching the pennies does not mean having to sacrifice on flavour. They include a crab courgetti spaghetti dish that uses tinned fish at a fraction of the cost of fresh. Plus, a spinach filo swirl demonstrates an inventive way of stretching six sausages to feed the family

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary journeys to some of the places closest to her heart, sharing memories from her past and creating new ones, while inspiring those she meets along the way with delicious recipes. Here Mary works behind the scenes at an Indian wedding, helping the caterers pull-off a huge event that feeds 400 people from morning to night, and adding a recipe of her own to the menu. Blown away by the traditions, customs and vibrancy of the wedding, Mary takes time to reflect on her own special day

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary visits Bristol, the city where she had her first job and where her son William studied at university. While in the city, Mary shares dishes including shakshuka, Tuscan chicken, and pear and blueberry galette. She also samples a Michelin-starred menu and tries her hand at street art

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary prepares tea for the England cricket team at Edgbaston in Birmingham, before stepping onto the crease for a quick coaching session with Jonny Bairstow and Ollie Pope. She then shares more of her favourite recipes, including jumbo lentil rolls and rich 'ultimate' brownies

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary explores the historic Jurassic Coastline, which runs from Devon to Dorset, meeting 21-year-old scallop diver Sam Shuker and talk to the local fisherman harvesting sugar kelp seaweed along the shore. She also has some mouth-watering dishes to share along the way, from a rich and creamy moules mariniere and a fresh nori noodle salad, to chicken, spinach and tomato lasagne, and salted caramel cake

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary heads to a festival set in the grounds of Cornbury Park in Oxfordshire, where performers from theatre, music and art come together - but food takes centre stage. She meets up with old friend, Michelin-starred chef Niklas Ekstedt, who'll be cooking for an intimate crowd of diners who sit around the chef's table and watch him work his magic. Sophie Ellis-Bextor will be opening the main stage and Mary is keen to meet up and share some of her recipes, including Mary's forest bean salad with lemon herb dressing served alongside her celery, blue cheese and sage risotto

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary heads to Edinburgh, where she meets runners and their families before the city's marathon, which she has been given the honour of starting. She is joined by her granddaughter Grace, with whom she shares her delicious home-made chocolate rocky road treats, and also visits the Royal Botanic Gardens to meet children from a local school. Inspired by the vegetables growing in the gardens, Mary cooks a fresh pea pesto spaghetti, while other recipes include minted lamb and an eggy bread avocado and ham sandwich

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: The food writer and Great British Bake Off judge is in her own kitchen to give step-by-step instructions for recipes for everyday meals and special occasions. She begins with advice on how to host a traditional tea party, sharing a clever trick for making sandwiches in advance and baking bite-sized scones for a cream tea, while her grand-daughters help her make orange butterfly cakes. Mary also visits a plantation in Cornwall to find out how tea is grown

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: The food writer and Great British Bake Off judge gives step-by-step instructions for recipes to impress guests at dinner parties, preparing two varieties of canapes, a salmon and asparagus starter, a main course of guinea fowl, and a chocolate tart for pudding. Mary also reveals a trick for cooking steak ahead of time that guarantees perfect results

programme.title: Area 51: The CIA's Secret Files
programme.desc: "Area 51: The CIA's Secret" covers the true story of ground-breaking research into aviation that took place at the Groom Lake Testing Facility, otherwise known as Area 51, which ensured U.S. aerial supremacy from the Cold War through to the present day. Utilizing CIA documents that have recently been declassified this program identifies specific individuals who worked at the top secret base in a variety of roles - the construction workers, pilots and security guards. Their personal testimonies provide a unique impression not just of the work that was carried out, but of the site itself. We reveal just how tight security had to be to keep the development of the U2, A12, HAVE BLUE and F117 Nighthawk aviation programs under wraps. This is a film that concentrates on delivering history and factual accuracy in a fresh and engaging style - one that answers the question of what really happened at Area 51.

Utilizing CIA documents that have recently been declassified this program identifies specific individuals who worked at the top secret base in a variety of roles - the construction workers, pilots and security guards. Their personal testimonies provide a unique impression not just of the work that was carried out, but of the site itself. We reveal just how tight security had to be to keep the development of the U2, A12, HAVE BLUE and F117 Nighthawk aviation programs under wraps. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the experts get to work on more heirlooms to bring them, and the memories they hold, back to life. programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team rejuvenate three cherished heirlooms that have fallen into disrepair.
First to receive an item in need of attention is our master of metalwork, Dominic Chinea. Nick Cope has brought in a 1950s rocking duck chair that has been enjoyed by countless children in his family. The cheery-looking duck originally belonged to his aunt, who tragically died as a child. His mother was devastated by the loss of her sister and kept the rocking chair as a reminder of her sibling. Nick remembers the fun that he and his brothers had playing in it and would love his grandson to have a go too. However, the duck is in a sorry state and certainly not safe for little ones to ride. Its paint is chipped, and the pale blue upholstery on the seat is too far gone. Dom gets to work on the metal frame while the queen of upholstery, Sonnaz Nooranvary, replaces the seat cushioning.
Braving the evening air with a jacket too delicate to wear is Fiona Elliott. She's hoping Suzie Fletcher's leather skills can save a memento of a brave and much-loved dad whom she called Pops. He was a glider pilot during the Second World War, making several dangerous Channel crossings to deliver troops and equipment to the front line. After the war, the warm jacket continued to serve him well when he worked on his family's farm. Fiona remembers being wrapped in the jacket while out in the fields with Pops. But this job is not for the faint-hearted - the leather is ripped and parched, and the fastenings are failing.
And finally, luthier Julyan Wallis is called upon to mend an old banjo that represents a father and son's love of music. Morgan Du Bruler is very attached to this damaged instrument, which belonged to his late father, who lived a fascinating life, travelling the world with this banjo by his side. It has been passed from father to son for generations, and it was Morgan's turn in 2008 when his father passed away. Morgan also inherited his father's passion for music, and he's keen to continue playing the banjo. However, the years have caught up with the instrument, and it could do with a total refurbishment. Julyan is only too happy to oblige.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Amanda Fisher presents a shattered jewellery box that she is praying Will Kirk can somehow salvage. The 1960s red velvet-lined box was her mother's and gifted to Amanda on her 16th birthday. A toy flying saucer and miniature library of Shakespeare's works are also afforded some much-needed attention. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team welcome the Poet Laureate Simon Armitage into the Repair Shop who brings with him a harmonium, the subject of one of his poems that brings back memories of his late father. Cobbler Dean Westmoreland is given the task of repairing Valerie's pair of children's leather clogs that were bought to help her sister with mobility issues balance in the 1950s. Kirsten Ramsay is tasked with reviving Martin's broken sculpture depicting his mother as a young woman made by a Czechoslovakian art student in 1947. Finally, Kirsty visits jeweller Richard Talman, hoping he can fix her mum's silver charm bracelet gifted to her mother by her father in the early 1960s

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team revive three treasured family heirlooms, resuscitating the precious memories that they hold.
First to arrive, looking for the assistance of goldsmith Richard Talman, is Chris Quinn. He has brought in a precious possession that belonged to his late mother, Esther. The silver shamrock brooch was gifted to Esther by her sisters and represented their family's Irish heritage. Esther was a caring mother to a large brood of nine children, often going without to make ends meet. This pretty brooch was one of the very few nice things she owned. Sadly, Esther died when Chris was a young lad, and he chose to keep the brooch as a reminder of his mum. However, it's now crying out for some TLC. A few years ago, Chris attempted to repair it himself, replacing the missing green precious stones with pieces of green glass, with limited success. To make matters worse, the clasp is also failing. Richard carefully gives the brooch a new lease of life.
Next to arrive is Claire Hardman. She is entrusting her childhood fascination to the care of silversmith Brenton West. The miniature brass replica kitchen was bought for her nana by her father in the 1960s. Nana collected brass ornaments and displayed them all over her home, and Claire and her sister loved playing with the kitchen every time they visited, pretending to cook with its tiny kettles and pots. It was only recently, decades later, that the kitchen was unearthed at her parents' house, and the happy memories came flooding back. It's not as shiny as she remembers, and several pieces are missing, but she's very keen for Brenton to get the kitchen back to its best.
Electronics whizz Mark Stuckey, alongside Dominic Chinea, waits eagerly for the final visitor, Wojciech Witoszynski. He's brought in a distinctive metal desk lamp that belonged to his Polish grandparents, who bought it from a fashionable manufacturer in the 1920s. Wojciech spent wonderful summer holidays with his grandmother and clearly remembers the lamp displayed in her home. Since he inherited it, he's been too fearful to switch it on, not trusting the outdated electrics. Now he hopes the team can bring the lamp and the memories it holds back to life.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team work their magic on three cherished possessions, returning them to delighted owners.
The first visitor of the day is Vicky Oakes. She's brought a mantelpiece clock she'd like horologist Steve Fletcher to take on. Her parents won the gold clock in a ballroom dancing competition. They danced together throughout their long, happy marriage and competed in several amateur dancing championships, winning countless trophies - but this particular clock was always treasured. Vicky lost her father several years ago, and her mother, now in her nineties, suffers from dementia. Vicky believes seeing and hearing the clock ticking again might spark some lovely memories on the dance floor with her childhood sweetheart. The clock has been silent since Vicky was a teenager, and Steve must clean and recondition every part of the mechanism to bring it back to life.
Next to arrive is Iain McPherson with a reminder of a heroic past that will test the mettle of silversmith Brenton West. He's brought a bookend that features a statue of an SAS soldier. It was awarded to Iain's father, who served in the SAS during the Second World War. Although he never spoke of his experiences, he was highly decorated for his bravery. The resin statue has lost its head in an unfortunate accident, and several other sections are chipped, but Brenton is very relieved to discover Iain has kept most of the detached pieces.
The third and final caller at the barn is Alison Ward with her son Alex. Inside their mysterious brown box is a miniature microscope, of a kind optics expert Richard Biggs has never seen before. It was given to Alison's father by her grandfather when he was a boy in the 1930s and has been passed down the family. Alison remembers using it as a child with her father, examining insects and other fascinations. Although small, it was in full working order until recent years. Richard must work extremely delicately and meticulously on the six tiny lenses to clean off decades of dust and grime.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live in volcanic hot spots on the ocean bed, areas that reach temperatures hot enough to melt lead and which may hold the secrets behind all life on Earth. Other strange creatures from the depths of the sea include bone-eating worms, fish that walk rather than swim, and hordes of squid. Plus, footage of sharks in a feeding frenzy over the dead body of a whale and the wildlife of the Midnight Zone in the Pacific, an area that never receives any natural light, forcing creatures to rely on their own bioluminescence

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live on coral reefs, including groupers, small predators that scientists believe are as intelligent as chimpanzees. These creatures have a remarkable aptitude for communication to the point where they can interact with other species including octopi and work together to catch prey. Plus, footage of a vast spawning event involving several different species of fish, coral and invertebrates, and time-lapse photography of coral polyps growing and dying, creating a structure visible from space

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. Special pressure-proof cameras are used to film sperm whales hunting for squid a kilometre beneath the surface and the impact of plastic pollution on the oceans is revealed

programme.title: Blue Planet II: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live in volcanic hot spots on the ocean bed, areas that reach temperatures hot enough to melt lead and which may hold the secrets behind all life on Earth. Other strange creatures from the depths of the sea include bone-eating worms, fish that walk rather than swim, and hordes of squid. Plus, footage of sharks in a feeding frenzy over the dead body of a whale and the wildlife of the Midnight Zone in the Pacific, an area that never receives any natural light, forcing creatures to rely on their own bioluminescence

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live on coral reefs, including groupers, small predators that scientists believe are as intelligent as chimpanzees. These creatures have a remarkable aptitude for communication to the point where they can interact with other species including octopi and work together to catch prey. Plus, footage of a vast spawning event involving several different species of fish, coral and invertebrates, and time-lapse photography of coral polyps growing and dying, creating a structure visible from space

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. Special pressure-proof cameras are used to film sperm whales hunting for squid a kilometre beneath the surface and the impact of plastic pollution on the oceans is revealed

programme.title: Blue Planet II: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Living Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: In 1945, as his Red Army advanced towards Berlin to liberate Europe from Nazism, Stalin pursued another goal - to join the countries of Eastern Europe to his empire. Citizens of those nations tell their stories of how their countries were occupied and transformed into communist states

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Living Under Soviet Occupation

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Living Under Soviet Occupation

The construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961 - physically dividing the German capital - stifled any hope of change

programme.title: Columbo

Crime drama, starring Peter Falk, James Read, Paul Burke, Jo Anderson and Nancy Walker

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: An agelong actress grows desperate to recapture her glory days and resorts to murdering her husband and making it look like suicide. Crime drama, starring Peter Falk, Janet Leigh, Sam Safe and John Payne

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: A horse trainer outraged by his brother's gambling debts murders both him and the bookie he owes money to, then claims one killed the other. Columbo is not convinced by his story and goes in search of the truth, and finds help from an unlikely source when a Mob enforcer is sent to investigate the bookie's death. Crime drama, starring Peter Falk, Rod Steiger and George Wendt

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: A prominent judge who was famed for his support of women's rights is found dead in his car, and the ensuing murder investigation leads the detectives to discover he was not as squeaky clean as he had seemed - and was linked to a case of corruption on the parole board. Hard-hitting drama, starring Christopher Meloni, Mariska Hargitay and Dann Florek

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell as Ash, whose romantic break in a remote cabin goes terrifyingly wrong when he accidentally unleashes an evil force that possesses his girlfriend.

programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

A mute ghost watches on as a family moves into a spacious suburban home and hidden tensions rise to the surface. Mother Rebekah seems to be involved in a crime, while teenage daughter Chloe, who is grieving after a friend's fatal overdose, begins to sense the unseen presence when it intervenes in the family's life.

Aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic Jack Torrance takes on the job of winter caretaker at the remote Overlook Hotel, despite a warning about the psychological strain the long months of isolation can cause. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Remakes (2026)
programme.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist
