programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Hailee Steinfeld and John Cena. A troubled teen discovers that her beaten-up Volkswagen Beetle is really a robot in disguise. Together they must protect the Earth from the evil Decepticons while fleeing government agents.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from director Michael Bay, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. Unsuspecting teenager Sam Witwicky holds the key to the survival of the human race when alien enemies the Autobots and the Decepticons arrive on Earth and continue their war.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Shia LaBeouf. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Remakes (2026)
programme.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist

programme.title: National Security
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Steve Zahn. A string of misunderstandings lead to by-the-book cop Hank Rafferty being dismissed from the force and serving a prison sentence for an apparent racial attack on police cadet Earl Montgomery. On his release, Hank is forced to take a job as a lowly security guard, where he is thrown together with an unexpected partner.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo and Riz Ahmed. Los Angeles loner Louis Bloom makes a living hustling, until one night he observes a freelance news photographer taking photos of a horrific car accident. Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hell-bent on revenge. Writer/Director Evan Ari Kelman's thriller, starring Hamish Linklater, Tramell Tillman and Brittany Snow

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Barbarian
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Georgina Campbell and Bill Skarsgård. Researcher Tess Marshall is in Detroit for a job interview but with hotels all booked up, she is forced to stay at an Airbnb in a run-down neighbourhood. She finds the room has been double-booked by Keith, but he kindly offers to take the couch. It's not long before Tess suspects there is more to her accommodation than meets the eye.

programme.title: Antlers
programme.desc: In an isolated Oregon town, a middle-school teacher and her sheriff brother become embroiled with an enigmatic student, whose dark secrets lead to terrifying encounters with an ancestral creature. Horror, starring Keri Russell, Jesse Plemons and Jeremy T Thomas

programme.title: Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Ashley Judd. Ice-hockey player Derek Thompson is an abusive and aggressive thug when he's out on the rink, with a reputation for knocking out his opponent's teeth. But that bad attitude comes back to haunt him after he dashes the hopes of his girlfriend's daughter - he's sentenced to work as a tooth fairy, and the tutu and wings are non-negotiable.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: Christmas fantasy starring Richard Attenborough and Elizabeth Perkins. Going against the wishes of her divorced mother, a sceptical young girl asks a mysterious department-store Santa Claus for the family she has always wanted.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Romantic comedy, based on Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew, starring Heath Ledger and Julia Stiles. Bianca Stratford is banned by her parents from going on a date until her older sister Katarina has a boyfriend, but unfortunately big sister has an excessively aggressive personality and only manages to send most boys running for cover. However, when a new guy arrives in town, Bianca's suitor Joey hits on a plan that could be the answer to their problem.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: An estranged couple discover new altitudes of fear aboard a single-engine Cessna plane. It was supposed to be a routine and casual flight to their friend's tropical island wedding but within minutes after takeoff, their pilot suffers a fatal heart attack, leaving them alone on the plane. They will only have one shot to save their lives, and there's no going back. Thriller, starring Allison Williams and Alexander Dreymon

programme.title: The Creator
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring John David Washington. Huge leaps in robotics and machine learning lead to an artificial intelligence apparently choosing to detonate a nuclear bomb over Los Angeles. Now outlawed across much of the world, all remaining AI-powered bots have relocated to New Asia where US soldier Joshua Taylor is sent to find information about a formidable weapon being developed by the machines.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Oscar Isaac and Domhnall Gleeson. A young software programmer is given the opportunity to spend time at the home of his company's reclusive chairman. But when he arrives he discovers that he will be required to be part of a strange experiment.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The History of Sound
programme.desc: In 1917 New England, unassuming music student Lionel Worthing meets David White in a bar. There is an instant connection between men with a mutual interest in the history of folk music, and they spark a passionate affair, conducted behind closed doors. Historical drama, starring Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor and Chris Cooper

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Samuel L Jackson. Businessman Ken Carter is recruited to improve the fortunes of a failing high-school basketball team. His exacting standards soon put the players under extreme pressure - both on the court and in the classroom.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Tom Hardy, Mark Rylance and Kenneth Branagh. During the 1940 British evacuation at Dunkirk, three individuals each fight to survive. As young soldier Tommy waits to escape the wartorn beach, a civilian sailor from Weymouth aids in the rescue efforts, while a Spitfire pilot provides air support and gains a singular perspective on the chaos taking place below.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Anti-Life
programme.desc: Sci-fi action horror starring Cody Kearsley and Bruce Willis. The denizens of a colony spaceship, including stowaway Noah and mechanic Clay, are at risk from a parasite that causes them to turn on each other.

programme.title: Deep Rising
programme.desc: Futuristic action horror starring Treat Williams and Famke Janssen. Having boarded the luxury liner Argonautica, a gang of thieves is surprised to find the vessel almost totally deserted - except for the presence of a terrifying creature from the deep.

programme.title: Mammoth
programme.desc: A sleepy town is thrown into turmoil when a meteor strikes the local museum, bringing a woolly mammoth residing in one of the display cases to life. The ancient beast goes on a violent rampage, leaving the residents with the task of hunting it down before it escapes into the outside world. Sci-fi thriller, starring Vincent Ventresca, Summer Glau, Tom Skerritt and Cole Williams

But is the shape-shifting organism a force for good or evil?

A journalist learns he contains the spirit of one of two heroes who stopped the evil forces the last time they attacked. He must find the reincarnation of the other hero before the monsters appear again. Fantasy adventure, starring Jason Behr and Amanda Brooks

programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a' coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a' trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke - forage for nature's bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Operation Ouch!
programme.desc:
Dr Xand's favourite cold virus is the rhinovirus: that's one that gets right up your nose and gives you the sniffles. So when the doctors get a question in the lab asking why your nose runs when you have a cold, they decide to become rhinoviruses and attack the body's defences through a giant nose. We also get a chance to see right inside Dr Xand's nostrils when he sticks a camera up his nose to show Dr Chris a real-life, flapping bogey specimen - gross alert!
Dr Ronx makes a whole class of schoolchildren forget where their elbows are with a mind-blowing body trick you can try on your friends, and in Ouch and About, Ethan wants to know which is the strongest bone in his body.
Over in Australia, six-year-old Jakobi is flown by helicopter to Sydney by the Flying Doctors because his local hospital thinks he needs specialist care. Lucy goes to the hospital in Edinburgh to find out why she's woken up with a swollen face. And in Liverpool, Michael's foot has been run over by a car, so no surprise that he's ended up in the emergency department. Ouch!

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc:
Did you know that the Victorians invented films? Not only that, but one of the first stars of the moving image was Queen Victoria! Using real footage recently restored by the BFI, this special show takes a Horribly Historical look at the Victorians' obsession with film. We see some of Queen Vicky's very first filmic appearances (also featuring an initially reluctant Tsar Nicholas I), and also how the Victorians became obsessed with filming everything, from their holidays abroad to strapping cameramen to the front of a moving train (using only ropes) to make 'Phantom Ride' films.
Along the way we also meet the Lumiere brothers (one of whom looks a lot like First Dates' Fred Sirieix), Kaiser Wilhelm II, notable Victorian actor Herbert Beerbohm Tree, and we see that the Victorians were also early adopters of Fake News. The episode ends with a show-stopping song that traces the evolution of film from the Victorians' first forays through to the blockbusters we see in the multiplexes today.

programme.desc: Dougie Vipond is in Aberdeenshire visiting Scotland's first inclusive farm, which was created by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene Stuart sails to Jura to see how the locals are coping with the huge deer population and finding new outlets for venison, while Anne Lundon revels how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. Shahbaz Majeed is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway recalls some of the treks he has completed on the Welsh islands. At Skomer Island, he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. At Flat Holm Island, Derek braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, He heads up north to Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and takes a sauna on a beach

programme.desc: Dougie Vipond is in Aberdeenshire visiting Scotland's first inclusive farm, which was created by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene Stuart sails to Jura to see how the locals are coping with the huge deer population and finding new outlets for venison, while Anne Lundon revels how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. Shahbaz Majeed is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway recalls some of the treks he has completed on the Welsh islands. At Skomer Island, he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. At Flat Holm Island, Derek braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, He heads up north to Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and takes a sauna on a beach

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Noel Fielding and Sandi Toksvig present the 2017 grand final, as the three remaining bakers compete to impress judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith and take home the trophy. For the final three challenges, they must prepare a batch of loaves, followed by a biscuit bake, and climaxing with a delicate, multi-layered, high-end patisserie showstopper to decide the winner

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu
programme.desc: Eight former winners compete to decide who will be cooking their canapes and starters for the incredible judges. Who will impress with their Christmas dishes

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu
programme.desc: Some of Britain's most prestigious chefs serve up their canapes and starters for the judges. Which delicious dishes will be chosen for the Christmas banquet

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu
programme.desc: The culinary experts go head-to-head with their mouth-watering dishes. Which delicious fish and main course will impress the judges and come out on top

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu
programme.desc: The incredible chefs cook their fish and mains in the hopes of impressing the judges. Which dish will dazzle enough to be chosen for the festive feast

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: Horror starring Sophie Wilde. Seventeen-year-old Mia goes to a party where her friends bring out a macabre centrepiece - an embalmed hand that enables the user to speak to the dead. Soon after, Mia experiences visions of her dead mother, and as the visions become more and more disturbing, Mia fears she has let something in that means to do her harm.

programme.title: Barbarian
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Georgina Campbell and Bill Skarsgård. Researcher Tess Marshall is in Detroit for a job interview but with hotels all booked up, she is forced to stay at an Airbnb in a run-down neighbourhood. She finds the room has been double-booked by Keith, but he kindly offers to take the couch. It's not long before Tess suspects there is more to her accommodation than meets the eye.

programme.title: Antlers
programme.desc: In an isolated Oregon town, a middle-school teacher and her sheriff brother become embroiled with an enigmatic student, whose dark secrets lead to terrifying encounters with an ancestral creature. Horror, starring Keri Russell, Jesse Plemons and Jeremy T Thomas

programme.title: Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Ashley Judd. Ice-hockey player Derek Thompson is an abusive and aggressive thug when he's out on the rink, with a reputation for knocking out his opponent's teeth. But that bad attitude comes back to haunt him after he dashes the hopes of his girlfriend's daughter - he's sentenced to work as a tooth fairy, and the tutu and wings are non-negotiable.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: Christmas fantasy starring Richard Attenborough and Elizabeth Perkins. Going against the wishes of her divorced mother, a sceptical young girl asks a mysterious department-store Santa Claus for the family she has always wanted.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Romantic comedy, based on Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew, starring Heath Ledger and Julia Stiles. Bianca Stratford is banned by her parents from going on a date until her older sister Katarina has a boyfriend, but unfortunately big sister has an excessively aggressive personality and only manages to send most boys running for cover. However, when a new guy arrives in town, Bianca's suitor Joey hits on a plan that could be the answer to their problem.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: An estranged couple discover new altitudes of fear aboard a single-engine Cessna plane. It was supposed to be a routine and casual flight to their friend's tropical island wedding but within minutes after takeoff, their pilot suffers a fatal heart attack, leaving them alone on the plane. They will only have one shot to save their lives, and there's no going back. Thriller, starring Allison Williams and Alexander Dreymon

programme.title: The Creator
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring John David Washington. Huge leaps in robotics and machine learning lead to an artificial intelligence apparently choosing to detonate a nuclear bomb over Los Angeles. Now outlawed across much of the world, all remaining AI-powered bots have relocated to New Asia where US soldier Joshua Taylor is sent to find information about a formidable weapon being developed by the machines.

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by guests Helen Flanagan, Henning Wehn, Miles Jupp and Alex Brooker to see who best understands what is going on in Britain today. Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent panel show

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Christmas Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent panel show's version of the words-and-numbers game, with team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson joined by guests Kathy Burke and David Baddiel for comic innuendos, unpredictable conundrums and plenty of laughs. Alex Horne and the Horne Section join Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Joe Wilkinson 'assists' maths whizz Rachel Riley at the board

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent panel show, with team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson joined by Richard Hammond, Carol Vorderman, Paul Foot and Matt Forde to see who best understands what is going on in Britain

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Elle wants a classy wedding at Liverpool's iconic Liver Building. Groom Phil's still picked an iconic building: the city's World Museum. Unfortunately for Elle, he's also picked a Jurassic Park theme.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Calvin the over-enthusiastic groom has just three weeks and £13k to plan the ultimate Scottish wedding for his bonnie bride-to-be Leanne. But while she's always dreamed of a simple Scottish do, Calvin has plans to create a monster. Will Calvin impress with a wedding at Loch Ness, or will his idea come back to bite him? Exec Prod: Sarah May; Prod Co: Renegade

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs? Aubrey and Jonathan are out of their depth on their 10-acre property complete with horses. Can our Jonathan help spruce up their 200-year-old farmhouse? And will Drew help them get back in the house-hunting saddle? Short:Aubrey and Jonathan are out of their depth on their 10-acre property. Can our pro bros help spruce up their 200-year-old farmhouse and get them back in the house-hunting saddle?

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs?Adina and Trey are in a race against time to sell their house before a subdivision floods the market with1000 new homes. But can authoritative Adina relinquish control to the twins?

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Clean Harbours is a hazardous waste disposal company, dealing with everything from hurricanes and oil spills to the 9/11 clean-up operation. Its chairman and founder Alan McKim is struggling to avoid losing highly trained employees as the business expands, so he goes undercover as a mechanic to discover the reason why

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three rival couples in Essex and east London compete in the dinner-party challenge, beginning with Spencer and Sara's simple Jewish feast. Reserved pair Lauren and Jack prepare a sophisticated menu reflecting the hosts' heritage in South Africa and Burma. For the final dinner, Paul and Ed opt for a flavourful fare that proves a bit much for those with a fondness for plainer food, and with the contest over, the competitors anxiously wait to discover which party was considered the best

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three pairs of partners from east London compete to win the £1,000 prize, including Stephen and Andrew who present a cosy menu inspired by their love of all things homely. Also vying to win are beauty-lovers Rob and Abi who hope to impress their guests by cooking up some glamorous cuisine, before comedian duo James and Kate hope a surprise performance will help them secure the cash

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples in Luton, Bedfordshire, battle it out in the culinary contest, beginning with Bridget and her husband Peter, whose menu of tried and tested dinner party favourites leaves their rivals distinctly unimpressed. Next to host are Shawn and Kendra, who prepare dishes based on their travels, before serving up a dessert that reflects their Canadian heritage. Finally, footballer Richard and his fiancee Marina decide to cook an Italian-inspired meal - but Richard proves to be more of a hindrance than a help in the kitchen. With the trio of parties complete, the couples reconvene to decide which pair hosted the best event

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In this revisit episode, chef Gordon Ramsay goes back to Mojito, the Junction (formerly known as Flamangos) and Bazzini to check in with the owners he helped in the past and find out whether his advice has been put to good use. Will he be pleased with their progress?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef heads to floundering soul food restaurant Blackberry's in Plainfield, New Jersey, but struggles to get his message across to indomitable owner Shelley. Her refusal to deal with the truth comes to a head when Gordon finds a dead mouse in the doorway, prompting him to step up his efforts to change her ways

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay is in New Jersey to help Rose Leone, who spent two years in a coma and came out of hospital to learn her son Michael had run her once-thriving Italian restaurant into the ground. With a menu of more than 126 dishes, the quality of the food is suffering, and even the chefs refuse to eat their own creations

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Mike & Nellie's Steakhouse in Oakhurst, New Jersey, where owner Mike Farber is mourning his father Nellie, who was also his business partner. Having been called in by the restaurateur's two daughters, Gordon faces the task of getting him to focus on his business, before tackling the bigger problem of rotting decor and a less-than-appealing menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Park's Edge restaurant in Atlanta, Georgia, where a series of spats with the local community are hampering its success. Owners Richard and Jorge's in-fighting has alienated locals, and the duo's suggestion that customer numbers are low because of racism has heightened tensions

programme.title: Taskmaster Bleeped
programme.desc: There are just two episodes left in the series, and if Richard Ayoade is going to make a late dash to snatch the Taskmaster trophy, he probably should have started that dash an episode or two ago... Still, he does demonstrate an enviable prowess in both shoe drawing and bucket wielding. Among the competitors still in with a shout of becoming champion, Nina Conti repeatedly insults a citrus fruit, Chloe Petts struggles to light a match, Isy Suttie focuses intently on the year 1991 and Matt Lucas bravely decides to cut Greg Davies down to size. Meanwhile, Little Alex Horne delights in making everyone wear aprons

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent quiz, with team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson joined by guests David Mitchell and Katherine Ryan. programme.title: Joe Lycett: More, More, More! How Do You Lycett? How Do You Lycett?
programme.desc: The performer's first stand-up touring show in several years is packed with more jokes, more comedy anecdotes and more inappropriate and arguably disturbing paintings - all in the hope of answering the age-old question: How do you Lycett?

programme.title: English Football League Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, including West Ham United v West Bromwich Albion at London Stadium, Wolverhampton Wanderers v Cardiff City at Molineux and Swansea City v Blackburn Rovers at Swansea.com Stadium in the Championship

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary brings his journey to a close on the surf-battered shores of Strandhill in Co Sligo, and meets a couple who have brought the bold, smoky flavours of the Basque country to the beach. Joined by a host of faces he's met along the way, Dermot then cooks a proper feast of fresh seafood, a deep, warming stew, and a fruit dessert that carries the sweetness of the whole journey

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Clodagh McKenna demonstrates recipes for the weekend, with the chef baking soda bread and helping her husband Harry to makes his signature scrambled eggs for a great breakfast. She also shares tips and tricks for making fresh homemade pasta to go with a simple roasted tomato sauce for the perfect Sunday supper

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: It is a busy time on the farm as the family prepares pigs for the butcher, ready to become sausages for their stall at the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz's plans are interrupted when she discovers an injured hen and takes the bird to her friend Debbie, a chicken expert. With Liz away, Kelvin enjoys a day with the boys, who get stuck into farm life as they help feed the pigs and build a new chicken coop, but there's a bigger problem in the front field, where flooding has put planting on hold

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: The chef heads to Boston, where he goes on shopping spree in the public market ahead of cooking with local ingredients. He visits a restaurant where cocktails are often inhaled rather than drunk and finishes by taking a trip to Fenway Park baseball stadium to live out a boyhood dream

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: The chef invites Clare Balding and Roger Taylor into his own home for a weekend chat show combining his love of food, the great outdoors and fast cars. Chefs Jose Pizarro and Meliz Berg join in the fun, cooking family favourite dishes

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Eric Idle and La Voix join Alan to check on the puppy school, herb grower Jekka McVicar has potions and spells for Halloween weekend and Best of British celebrates Monty Python

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: On her morning rounds, Liz takes a moment to appreciate the life the family have built on the farm, but their peaceful routine is interrupted when calf Elizabeth develops a worrying wheeze. Fearing pneumonia, the illness that claimed beloved Cherry last year, Kelvin and Liz call in vet Hugo to investigate. Meanwhile, with the pigs gone, the family begin transforming the old pig field into a vegetable patch

programme.title: Talking Royals
programme.desc: A weekly round-up of royal news, with expert analysis from ITV News' royal editor Chris Ship and expert Lizzie Robinson, and guests

programme.title: Cooking with the Stars
programme.desc: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as former Strictly professional Karen Hauer, comedian Seann Walsh and five-time Olympic cycling gold medallist Laura Kenny go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle for the last two places in the next round. With the help of their mentors, they have to produce food that provides healthy and nutritious benefits, with two of the stars facing the cook-off, after which one will leave the competition

programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: The World Is Not Enough
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Sophie Marceau and Robert Carlyle. After the death of oil magnate Sir Robert King in a booby trap, agent James Bond becomes bodyguard to King's daughter, Elektra, to protect her from her father's killer.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: Adil Ray hosts as Faye Tozer and Lee Latchford-Evans of Steps take on comedian Russell Kane and Big Brother's Will Best to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords

programme.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
programme.desc: Ben Shephard asks the questions as Jonathan Ross, Katie Piper and Antony Cotton answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity

programme.title: The Chase

They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. Special pressure-proof cameras are used to film sperm whales hunting for squid a kilometre beneath the surface and the impact of plastic pollution on the oceans is revealed

programme.title: Blue Planet II: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The first of three programmes about the wildlife, landscape and culture in different areas of the country explores the Sierra Madre mountains, and reveals how this rugged landscape has shaped the nation. This chain of peaks includes several volcanoes and is home to a wide variety of animals, including black bears, monarch butterflies, orchid bees and quetzals. The programme also visits the ruins of an ancient Aztec shrine and the blue agave plant which grows in the mountains is used in making tequila

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: Exploring the forests of the Yucatan Peninsula, which contain the ruins of the Mayan civilisation and a wide range of wildlife, including jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds. The region also holds a secret that is the key to how Mexico's people and animals are able to survive during the country's dry season

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The series concludes by exploring the north of the country, which is dominated by two deserts - the Sonoran and the Chihuahuan. The programme explores the conditions that have shaped this environment, and reveals how animals including prairie dogs, pygmy owls and aplomado falcons have adapted to thrive in these arid conditions

It begins with the 12 months before the attack on Pearl Harbour, which belatedly brought their country into the conflict that cost the lives of more than 50 million people worldwide

programme.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
programme.desc: Paul Murton sets out to visit some of the many islands that lay off the coastline. Heading to Foula and Fair Isle - the most remote island communities in Britain - he makes a nerve-racking visit to 'Da Snekk o' da Smallie' - a pothole in the cliffs of Foula that leads through to the Atlantic shore on the island, and learns about the beautiful knitting patterns that have made Fair Isle famous around the word

programme.title: Treasures Decoded
programme.desc: How a team of experts claims to have finally uncovered evidence of an epic catastrophe that may explain the loss of Atlantis, a great civilisation purportedly swallowed by the sea

programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past
programme.desc: Centuries ago, canals were the liquid highways of Britain, transporting raw materials and finished goods all over the country. Their arrival kick-started the Industrial Revolution, which was to turn Britain into a superpower. The very first water superhighway was the Bridgewater Canal, completed in 1761 to carry coal to Manchester from the mines in Worsley. Here, a team of archaeologists from Salford University roots out this industrial past, working with volunteers to excavate the very coal mine that inspired the creation of the canal

programme.title: Die Alone
programme.desc: A young couple flee the city during a zombie outbreak, only to be involved in a car crash. When the man awakes, his girlfriend is missing, so he bands together with a rugged survivalist to find his partner - but he only has selected memories of what he has been through. Apocalypse drama, starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Douglas Smith, Frank Grillo and Kimberley-Sue Murray

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure. SpongeBob the friendly sea sponge sets out from his home town of Bikini Bottom with his starfish friend, Patrick, to reclaim King Neptune's stolen crown.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: Flushed Away
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Hugh Jackman, Kate Winslet and Ian McKellen. Posh rodent Roddy St James leads a sheltered life in a Kensington mansion, with his every need catered for by his wealthy owners. But his life as a pampered pet comes to an end when he's flushed down the toilet to a subterranean world where the population is being threatened by an evil toad.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: Film noir starring Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame and Lee Marvin. When tough detective Dave Bannion is assigned to investigate a colleague's suicide, he is sceptical about the reasons given for his death. Forced to work under cover, he discovers the existence of a suicide note that implicates a brutal Mob boss.

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hell-bent on revenge. Writer/Director Evan Ari Kelman's thriller, starring Hamish Linklater, Tramell Tillman and Brittany Snow

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Weird Science
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Anthony Michael Hall, Ilan Mitchell-Smith and Kelly LeBrock. One stormy night, high-school computer nerds Gary and Wyatt feed all the components of their perfect woman into their PC and are stunned at the result. The room explodes and out of the smoke appears the beautiful Lisa, the answer to every young man's dream.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Comedy starring Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter. California teenagers Bill and Ted are eager to succeed in a history exam because failure will result in Ted being sent to military school and end the duo's hopes of becoming heavy metal rock stars. Then a representative from the future arrives and assists their studies by enabling them to travel back in time.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Comedy starring Burt Reynolds, Sally Field and Jackie Gleason. Bandit is a maverick driver who never refuses a challenge, and no cop - or "smokey" - is going to stop him. However, Sheriff Buford T Justice has other ideas, and the chase is on as the Bandit and his friends try to get a truckload of illicit beer from Texarkana, Texas, to Atlanta, Georgia.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three single women dabble in magic to conjure up the perfect lover, and unintentionally summon Satan himself, who seduces them one by one. They come to realise the danger the lecherous devil presents and decide to end their relationships, but the infernal rogue does not take kindly to rejection. Fantasy comedy based on John Updike's novel, with Jack Nicholson, Cher, Michelle Pfeiffer and Susan Sarandon

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Comic fantasy based on the book by Roald Dahl, starring Mara Wilson and Danny DeVito. Matilda, the daughter of Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, has adored reading from a precociously early age, but her parents refuse to let her go to school. Until, that is, her father sends her to the unforgiving Miss Trunchbull's Crunchem Hall, where she discovers that she has other more useful gifts.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.
