Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan a tha a dhìth airson ar misneachadh gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Thairis air an t-sreath, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas mu charaidean, an dachaigh, an teaghlach, obair agus an aimsir am measg gu leòr eile ann an dòigh a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne: www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan a tha ri fhaighinn air BBC Sounds.

Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

Baker Briony May Williams finds out why Cumbria is the home of sticky toffee pudding

Meeting locals, he discovers passion and pride in their history, culture and identity, and seeks to understand the challenges each region faces today. He begins at Siccar Point in Berwickshire, which was the site of an extraordinary 18th-century discovery and is a place of pilgrimage for earth scientists from across the world

In the UK, controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. Dec, who's desperate to go home with his new girlfriend, seems to have made a miraculous recovery. But his psychological struggles threaten everything

programme.title: The Taliban's War On Women: Dispatches
programme.desc: The reality of women's lives under the Taliban's increasingly repressive rule, following Afghans in exile as they go on a mission to rescue victims who are desperate to escape. First-hand testimony speaks of torture and sexual violence, and a growing number see suicide as the only way out. Told by activists and ordinary women, in the face of risks to their freedom, these deeply personal stories of courage reveal the human cost of defying the Taliban

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up to Cancer, With Love Meghan, Tempting Fortune, Fear, Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code, Last One Laughing, Jeopardy and a This Morning feature on toenails. From March 2025

programme.title: Trauma: My Broken Brain
programme.desc: Documentary telling the stories of three young people who have survived strokes, leaving one of them bedbound, another using a wheelchair, and the third in a coma. As they fight to reclaim their futures and wrestle with a situation that is not expected so early in life, the three survivors and their families face challenges, setbacks and unexpected moments of joy

programme.title: The Experiment
programme.desc: Mat Fraser and Sophie Morgan invite members of the public to take part in a provocative experiment inside a new 'progressive' residential facility. Visitors are encouraged to take a closer look, meet the residents and discover a very different type of care. But as the experiment unfolds, nothing is quite as it seems. As events take an increasingly unsettling turn and troubling ideas emerge, will anyone question what's really going on?

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Loud and proud duo Fay and Wayne kick things off in the Midlands with their comfy country cuisine featuring a beef Wellington main course, and already the competition is on for ditzy couple Sam and Tony who'll be serving the same dish. Day two sees retired lovebirds Rob and Maz hosting with their take on nouveau cuisine. Finally it's Sam and Tony's turn to go all out to dazzle with a glitz and glamour themed soirée, but will it be enough to pocket them the cash prize of £1,000?

Western, starring Audie Murphy, Kathryn Grant, Hope Emerson and Jeff Donnell

programme.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, has vowed since boyhood to kill a man he has never seen - his own father, who seemingly deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: Decision at Sundown
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. After years of searching, Bart Allison rides into Sundown to kill the man that he holds responsible for the death of his wife. However, the object of his vengeance is now under the protection of the town sheriff.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Romantic sci-fi drama starring Emily Blunt and Matt Damon. A seemingly random series of events brings ambitious politician David Norris together with ballet dancer Elise Sellas, with whom he falls in love. But was their meeting down to chance, and are there now supernatural forces conspiring to keep them apart?

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: Ex Machina

programme.title: I'm Your Man

Initially unsettled by her new partner, Alma reacts with hostility, but over time her feelings unexpectedly evolve.

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: The A&E staff of King's College Hospital in London treat patients involved in accidents, including a construction worker who broke his leg in three places and suffered injuries to his chest after being trapped under a cherry picker. programme.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
programme.desc: The air ambulance teams help Lesley, who's been injured in a car crash in Northumberland, Arthur, who has a dangerously fast heartbeat, and a cyclist who has a nasty crash in a remote part of Cumbria

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: Paramedics treat a motorcyclist who's been catapulted over his handlebars and may have broken his hip. The crew help a young woman who's having a panic attack to focus on her breathing. A man falls down stairs at work, damaging his knee, and a woman has an excruciating headache, and a patient with a history of cardiac issues is complaining of chest pain

programme.title: The Perfect Pitch
programme.desc: Ending their tour of north Wales in search of the perfect pitch, the seasoned campers arrive at The Oyster Farm Caravan Site on Anglesey. Marine biologist-turned-campsite host Shaun welcomes the campers with freshly caught oysters and his own oyster gin, before sending them on an aquatic tour of the nearby Puffin Island. The week's winner of the coveted plaque and £2,000 cash prize is then announced

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Jon and Julia Shorrock host the first round of the B&B competition from their four-star Derwent House in West Sussex. The guests are split by gender to sample the area, with the men firing machine guns at a shooting range and the women relaxing at a spa - but a carpeted bathroom and shower without hot water raise questions

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Peter and Sharron Sorsky invite their fellow competitors to Kirkby Park B&B in Liverpool, but the presence of a security camera on the outside of the house leaves one guest feeling uneasy. Room inspections uncover all manner of unsightly problems, but a tour of nearby Knowsley Safari Park gives the contestants a chance to enjoy themselves

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Andy and Julian Banner-Price host the competition at their expensive B&B Plas Dinas Country House in Snowdonia, giving their new guests the priciest rooms. Peter and Sharron Sorsky are still reeling from their feedback forms and immediately find fault with the accommodation, and the group is taken to wash bedding the old-fashioned way at the local slate museum

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Annette McAnespie welcomes the group to Hazelwood Farm in Crayke, North Yorkshire, for the final B&B visit. The initial impressions are favourable and Peter and Jon begin to bond for the first time during a mosaic class, but not everyone feels up to the planned activity of a cycling tour

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The contestants meet one last time at Annette McAnespie's farm in Crayke, North Yorkshire, to discover how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers and to air their grievances, before the week's winner is announced

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Mum-of-two Kelly takes her guests on a Mexican adventure. What will accountant Marta, podiatrist Paula, parkour instructor Brad and supporting actor Sohan make of a fun-filled fiesta?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Supporting actor Sohan brings international flavours to his colourful dinner party, inspired by his Punjabi and Kenyan heritage. But will his experimental dishes and hidden talent impress?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Dinner party three in Essex sees podiatrist Paula treat her guests to a nostalgic night with old school foodie classics and some 1970s songs. However, the party vibes come to an abrupt halt over dessert when Sohan makes a shocking observation about the host

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Straight-talking accountant Marta hosts the fourth night in and around Essex as, dressed in a full bridal gown, she lays on a Polish wedding for her guests. Marta's been critical all week and Brad is just waiting for her to slip up; he especially lays into the main and compares it to eating dirt. With bickering, some dodgy food and singing, it turns out to be a classic wedding

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Energetic parkour instructor Brad hosts the final night from in and around Essex. Brad's been outspoken all week and now it's time for him to put his money where his mouth is and impress his fellow contestants. However, it soon seems he may have bitten off more than he can chew

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Farmer's daughter Mandy Sowray and her friend Anny Harrison host first at Laskill Country House in Helmsley, North Yorkshire. Chris Witton and Saroop Ram from the Swan Hotel feel right at home, but tech-savvy Colin and Ben Warburg from Scalford Hall Hotel fail to connect from the start. During the afternoon's hay-bale race, youngsters Charlie Thompson and Lauren Tucker from the Abbey Hotel fail to stack up to the challenge. At dinner, Mandy bigs up her banger qualifications, but at breakfast she fails to crack Chris's order. Colin's feedback leaves unanswered questions for Mandy

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Chris Witton and his spiritual friend Rammy hope that straightforward value for money will win them the competition, as they host at the Swan Hotel in Telford. A Yorkshire pudding-making competition leaves confident cooks Mandy and Anny thinking there's more to youngsters Charlie and Lauren than meets the eye. At dinner, Rammy opens up about his troubled past. Colin has a rude awakening in the morning. At feedback time, Chris has a change of heart about some of his guests

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Colin Warburg and his student son Ben hope that their 81-room country pile - Scalford Hall Hotel in Melton Mowbray, Leicestershire - will wow their rivals. However, Chris and Rammy are still smarting from their feedback and think that Colin is playing games. After an afternoon crate stacking competition on the hotel's high wire course, Colin gets a grilling at dinner. A lukewarm reaction to breakfast only adds to Colin's woes and when he sees his feedback he suspects that retribution is at hand

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The final visit is to the Abbey Hotel in Battle, East Sussex, run by confident young colleagues Charlie Thompson and Lauren Tucker. However when Charlie and Lauren's guests arrive, Colin and Ben feel the squeeze and Chris and Rammy find themselves in a sticky situation. On an afternoon at the archery range, scores are settled. At dinner, straight-talking Chris can't help but be impressed, but when the conversation turns to parking, the guests are in a jam with their hosts. Later, Colin's feedback leaves Lauren wanting answers

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&B owners meet up to settle some scores. Laskill Country House host Mandy wants to crack where she went wrong with breakfast and why Colin and Ben failed to connect with her, while Chris and Rammy from The Swan Hotel wish to question Lauren on her room flaws and get to the bottom of Colin's bedroom nightmares

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: The deals are flying in Colorado when a property proves plentiful. Mike bids big money on a 1961 Messerschmitt in Massachusetts. And can Danielle sell the guys' rare Fiat cutaway car?

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Documentary set inside Woodgreen animal charity, following staff who are committed to matching their homeless dogs with prospective owners. In the first episode, a terrified terrier known as Tiny arrives after his owner of five years is taken into care, while child-friendly Daisy, a Cairn terrier, is the only one of Wood Green's charges deemed gentle enough for the Kerry family from Peterborough. Plus, Jack Russell Mozart and Zeus, a recently abandoned Staffordshire bull terrier, each try to charm couple Paul and Elf

programme.title: The Secret Life of the Zoo
programme.desc: Documentary revealing the secret life of the animals of Chester Zoo, one of Britain's most popular zoos, using new micro-rig technology to capture the behaviour of the animals and their close relationships with their keepers. Vets at Chester Zoo treat an elephant calf for the herpes virus, the same virus that resulted in the deaths of two calves the year before. A breeding phenomenon plays out among the extraordinary cardinal fish, and the zoo's humboldt penguins welcome 16 new members to their colony

programme.title: Our Farm Next Door: Amanda, Clive and Kids
programme.desc: The girls hold their first-ever sleepover at the new Owen family home, and Nancy and Clemmie set off on horseback into the wildflower meadow for their first ride since winter. The whole family moves furniture that Amanda's collected over the years into Anty John's as the house's interior finally begins to take shape

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo traces the early 20th-century roots of the Spanish Civil War, which divided his family and sent his father into exile. The former politician discovers a nation fractured at the time by social tensions and regional loyalties, which today offer a rich diversity of cultures to delight the tourist. After arriving in Majorca from Barcelona, Michael spoils himself enjoying spectacular scenic views aboard a 1912 vintage railway and a 1913 tram. He also gets trampled underfoot at the bottom of a Catalan 'people steeple' and learns to make the perfect paella

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with a 1936 edition of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo ventures onto the European rail network, beginning an emotional rail journey which takes him deep into his family's past. In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Michael's final stop is on the border with France at Canfranc station, where he learns of the role the old terminus played in the evacuation of Jews during the Second World War

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Etaples Military Cemetery in France, as the team discovers the personal stories behind treasured objects associated with the First World War. Among the unique items brought in are two poppies that were picked from Ypres in 1915, a tray that was made by a solider blinded by mustard gas, and a document that was part of the political process to bring the war to an end. Plus, the stories of an Indian army surgeon and a volunteer nurse and ambulance driver who became the first woman to earn the Military Medal for bravery

Co-writer/director Sophia Takal's horror remake, starring Imogen Poots, Lily Donoghue, Aleyse Shannon and Brittany O'Grady

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding and Emma Thompson. London, 2017: life could be better for twenty-something chaos magnet Kate, who has her heart set on being a singer but works all year round as an elf in a Covent Garden store. Then she meets too-good-to-be true Tom. Could romance be in the air?

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Criminal Minds
programme.desc: Following an encounter with Lynch, Dr. Reid suffers from a brain injury and is visited by ghosts from his past. The BAU makes a discovery about Lynch that affects Rossi personally.

programme.title: Criminal Minds: Evolution
programme.desc: When a family annihilator abducts a teen girl, the Behavioral Analysis Unit works the case on either side of the country to save her. But an unlikely connection to a mysterious kit leads to a bigger investigation, and at the center of it is Penelope Garcia.

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: A teenage model is raped, assaulted with a hammer and left for dead outside a hospital, and is also found to have taken amphetamines. A photographer and his business partner are soon arrested for the crime - but finding a motive proves harder than anticipated. Drama, starring Christopher Meloni, Mariska Hargitay and Dann Florek

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: Stabler and Benson investigate when the body of a murdered prostitute is found in Times Square, and are shocked at the insensitivity with which a cocky vice detective is handling the crime. Relieving him of duty, they soon link the woman's death to the murders of two other call girls, and start to believe a serial killer may be at work. Police drama, starring Christopher Meloni and Mariska Hargitay

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Ideal World Shopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Police question the legitimacy of the name a driver gives them.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tony's one-time Baltimore PD partner Danny Price is murdered in a manner that suggests the port-to-port killer has struck again. However, a key difference in the way the victim was bound suggests the crime was actually the work of a copycat, forcing the investigators to consider whether Price had any enemies

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: New evidence reveals the serial killer has infiltrated the agency and is targeting a member of the NCIS team, prompting Gibbs to seek the guidance of his former mentor Mike Franks. A lead from Barrett's squad reveals the CIA has also been tracking the murderer - and its findings suggest the culprit could be an even deadlier foe than anticipated

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs and the team attend the funeral of a fallen colleague before resuming their hunt for the man they believe to be the port-to-port killer. Vance frantically researches the suspect's background to learn more about his motivations and discover who his next target could be - but one of the investigators follows a clue that leads to danger

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: Detectives Fontana and Green investigate the strangling of a promising student at a specialist school. A suspect is soon arrested and charged - but formidable defence attorney Rebecca Shane (Kathleen Turner) tries to get him cleared by arguing he committed the crime while under the influence of prescription medication. Crime drama, starring Dennis Farina and Jesse L Martin

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: A woman admits to murdering her teenage son, but pleads mitigating circumstances, claiming she killed him out of fear that he would become a menace to society, like his criminal father. McCoy and Borgia charge her, but a clever defence attorney argues that she did society a favour and suggests new video evidence might sway a jury. Drama, starring Annie Parisse and Sam Waterston

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: The killing of a private military contractor leads Fontana and Green to the brother of a man who died because of the victim's incompetence and another who witnessed the tragedy in Iraq. Once in court, one of the suspects claims he knows where a group of men was keeping an Iraqi PoW

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: Green and Cassady investigate the death of corporate attorney Charles Dillon, whose body was found in a hotel room, and discover the company he was working for was in the process of being indicted. Their inquiry leads them to the female CEO and her relationship with a prostitute. Crime drama, starring Jesse L Martin

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: A man's death offers no immediate explanation, until the autopsy points Green and Cassady in the direction of illegally harvested donor bones, which the dead man had received in a transplant. However, McCoy and Rubirosa struggle to bring the case to prosecution when it becomes clear they can only get the necessary evidence by testing another transplant recipient

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: The husband of a well-known actress is gunned down outside a shop while holding a baby the couple had recently adopted from Africa. The murder inquiry soon turns into an investigation about a child's death when the identity of the adopted infant comes under question. Guest starring Anna Chlumsky (My Girl) and Jennifer Beals (Lie to Me)

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: An estate agent and two clients discover the body of Lt Com Maya Burris, a naval attache who had been working in Egypt, and her detective husband Nick arrives on the scene to demand answers. Using documents discovered on the victim's boat, Abby links her to Barry Norton, who is suspected of having sold government secrets to a Middle Eastern terrorist group known as the SRC

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs goes into his favourite diner for a cup of coffee and finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun, forcing him to question choices he has made in the past and present. The action then flashes back a few days to when he and the rest of the team members were investigating the death of a petty officer on board USS Gentry, which has been undergoing repairs in dry dock. The 200th episode of the crime drama, starring Mark Harmon

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A Navy captain wearing a colourful costume underneath his uniform is shot and killed in a flower shop, and further investigation reveals he was leading a double life as a masked vigilante. Vance brings in Tony's ex-fiancee, journalist Wendy Miller, who claims the victim had been trying to expose a scandal, and as the team pursues the case, a real-estate scam is uncovered. Guest starring Perrey Reeves (Entourage)

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: Carisi must put aside his role as prosecutor when he is called as a witness in a trial, while Benson helps a rape survivor who is struggling with her recovery

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: The pregnant daughter-in-law of a prominent religious leader is found raped and murdered in her hotel room, and investigations reveal a dark secret behind the family's respectable facade. Acclaimed US police drama, starring Dann Florek, Christopher Meloni and Mariska Hargitay

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: A teenage girl claims she was assaulted by a man she met over the internet, leading the police to launch a massive sting operation to bring the culprit to justice - but the decision to place Munch in the role of the online youngster has higher authorities up in arms. Hard-hitting crime drama, starring Richard Belzer, Christopher Meloni and Mariska Hargitay

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Action thriller sequel starring Lucas Black. To avoid jail for illegal street racing, a bad-boy teenager is sent to Japan to stay with his estranged father. However, his discovery of drifting, a new style of racing reliant on the use of oversteering, soon gets him into more trouble.

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the characters created by EB White, starring Geena Davis and Hugh Laurie, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox as the lovable talking mouse. Stuart loses his heart to a little bird called Margalo when he nurses her back to health following an encounter with a vicious falcon. But his new-found love hides a dark secret.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine and Josh Hutcherson. A teenage adventurer locates an island inhabited by monster lizards, giant bees and a gold volcano.

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Super Charlie
programme.desc: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Kirsten Dunst, Gregory Smith and featuring the voice of Tommy Lee Jones. When an overeager toy designer installs state-of-the-art military microchips into a line of action figures, the result is a battle royal between the Commando Elite and the peaceful Gorgonites. The problem is that the battleground is the suburban household of young Alan Abernathy.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jackie Chan. On an assignment to track down an arms dealer in Australia, a Hong Kong policeman makes contact with the local Triad and discovers that the Russian intelligence officer who recruited him has criminal motives.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three single women dabble in magic to conjure up the perfect lover, and unintentionally summon Satan himself, who seduces them one by one. They come to realise the danger the lecherous devil presents and decide to end their relationships, but the infernal rogue does not take kindly to rejection. Fantasy comedy based on John Updike's novel, with Jack Nicholson, Cher, Michelle Pfeiffer and Susan Sarandon

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Comedy starring Marlon Wayans and Shawn Wayans. Two black brothers are threatened with expulsion from the FBI following a failed drugs bust. In an attempt to save their jobs, they disguise themselves as rich, white socialite sisters to uncover and foil a kidnapping plot.

programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

Writer/director Zach Braff's drama, starring Florence Pugh and Morgan Freeman

When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

The children become inseparable, and as adults they embark on a destructive relationship. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta 's a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àiteachan air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she'll introduce words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication.
We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. The intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh
programme.desc: Calum Maclean explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform. In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a' coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a' trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a' giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a' lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a' dèanamh air Ceann a' Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a' gabhail cuairt a dh'Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a' beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke - forage for nature's bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
programme.desc: Live from Washington DC, Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As polls close and votes pour in across the country, the balance of power in Washington is at stake. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

When the gymnast leaves, Toodloo is eager to try it out and leaps up on the beam, performing a gymnastic routine. When the Twirlywoos drop into the boat they land on the pebbles, where they struggle to keep their balance. Chickedy and Chick jump from pebble to pebble like stepping stones, until they unwittingly land on top of Peekaboo's shell. Peekaboo runs off with Chickedy and Chick balancing on top! They career around the boat crashing into the other pebbles, and into Great Big Hoo and Toodloo, ending up with everyone balanced precariously on top of Peekaboo!

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: Animated fantasy featuring the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos, and songs by Randy Newman. In jazz-age New Orleans, a waitress and a playboy prince seek the help of some quirky creatures as they try to break a witch doctor's spell that has turned them into frogs.

Unable to accept the death of his pet pooch, young science whizz Victor performs an experiment that brings him back to life. But his secret is soon discovered and it's not long before havoc is wreaked all over town.

Plucky mermaid Ariel, daughter of King Triton, is unhappy with her life beneath the waves and makes a deal with devious sea witch Ursula to help her go on land and meet her prince.

A school trip to a museum takes an unexpected turn for teenager Percy Jackson when he is revealed to be the son of Greek god Poseidon. He is immediately plunged into a quest to retrieve a lightning bolt belonging to Zeus and prevent a divine war.

When a stranger informs them that one of their ancestors might have been involved in the plot to assassinate President Lincoln, treasure hunter Ben Gates and his archaeologist father Patrick set out to clear the family name. Their quest takes them to Buckingham Palace and the White House, where they uncover evidence of a lost city of gold.

Together with a young French couple, Richard embarks on a hazardous journey to reach the island, but will they really find paradise?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A look at one of Britain's worst air disasters - the crash of British European Airways 548, which saw 118 people lose their lives. The plane plummeted shortly after taking off from Heathrow on June 18, 1972 and narrowly missed a main road before crashing into a field. Investigators were forced to rely on witness testimony to determine why the plane nosedived as there was no cockpit voice recorder on board, but both the investigation process and its results were deemed controversial

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: Derek picks out a super-low-mileage MGC and the team pay a little too much to secure it.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Acclaimed chronicle of the Second World War, beginning with an account of Hitler's ascent to power at a time when the Germans were stricken by humiliating military defeat, runaway inflation and economic depression. The Nazi leader's promises of regained national pride and prosperity struck a chord with millions of ordinary citizens, and he was elected on a tidal wave of popular support. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: War Factories

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Eltham Palace in South London. Finds include a collection of Gerry and Sylvia Anderson puppets, two unknown paintings by Mexican Marxist artist Diego Rivera, whose work documented working class culture in the 1960s, a well-preserved mammoth tooth, a newspaper printing plate telling the story of the moon landings, and letters written by an Army officer captured by the IRA in the 1920s

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Andy, 36, is brought in after a motorcycle accident with a fractured femur that needs realignment. Staff fear 27-year-old Connor, who has fallen off a roof, may have bleeding on his brain. In the urgent treatment unit, 25-year-old Adrian has suffered injuries to his face and been bitten on his arm after breaking up a fight in the city centre

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Sam's moral high ground is tested at a warehouse sex party, where she invites her new hook-up, Tess. Abi attempts to make her boyfriend Tom jealous, while Ethan spends the night trying to figure out if Aaron is gay. Impulsive decisions threaten to ruin everything

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Ethan and Abi show up to support Sam's reading of her new work at an open mic night but when a short film from the warehouse sex party plays, the trio are forced to confront how much they've all changed since they met. Meanwhile, Ethan and Aaron blur even more boundaries

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade demonstrates an enviable prowess in both shoe drawing and bucket wielding. Nina Conti repeatedly insults a citrus fruit and Chloe Petts struggles to light a match, Isy Suttie focuses intently on the year 1991 and Matt Lucas bravely decides to cut Greg Davies down to size. Meanwhile, Little Alex Horne delights in making everyone wear aprons

programme.title: The Last Leg
programme.desc: Adam Hills, Josh Widdicombe and Alex Brooker are joined by Katherine Ryan, Dan Tiernan and Queens of the Stone Age for a comic review of the significant moments of the past seven days. As usual, the hashtag #isitok paves the way for the gang to round up, examine and explain the leading and most entertaining news stories of the week

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Essex, partners Mike and Heather hope to impress their guests with a menu of Mediterranean-inspired dishes, but Fussy eaters Jess and Salv can't hide their true feelings about the starter

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer head to Stevenage, Hertfordshire, where Steven and Adeola are in desperate need of an intervention to resolve their three-year debate. Their new-build, three-bedroom detached home is bursting at the seams, and a catalogue of issues has Steven yearning for pastures new. With a lack of storage and dysfunctional layout - that is exacerbated when family come to stay - patience has finally run out. Steven wants out but Adeola is not for moving and refuses to give up on their home. Can Phil and Kirstie help them decide which way to turn?

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody turns to Sam's little black book for help in his search for a girlfriend, so the would-be Lothario tries to come up trumps. Comedy, starring Ted Danson and Woody Harrelson

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier tries to boost Diane's confidence by praising her terrible dancing, unwittingly prompting her to audition for the Boston ballet. Meanwhile, Cliff buys a new Italian sports car and sells his clapped-out station wagon to Woody. Comedy, starring Shelley Long and Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug reluctantly invites lonely Arthur to join him and his friends for a Friday night of beer and pool, but the evening is brought to a crashing halt by a bar-room fight

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie gives in to temptation and sells her engagement ring so she and Doug can buy a hot tub and satellite dish. American comedy, starring Kevin James and Leah Remini

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie enrols Doug and herself on a course on the Victorian novel at college. He soon feels way out of his league but resolves to answer 10 questions in class in a bid to impress his fellow students

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray is shocked to discover his parents planned to divorce when he was a child, and only stayed together to help him recover from an accident. Tormented by the thought they have never really been happy together, he begins to blame himself for all the misery in their marriage

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra convinces Ray to give working from home a try, but things don't turn out as she had planned

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra decides to have a go at writing a children's book, but makes the mistake of asking Ray to help - little realising his competitive streak will jeopardise the entire project. Ray Romano stars

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Frasier's unemployment makes him increasingly tetchy with everyone - and when he blows up at Martin, Roz suggests Martin moves in with Niles

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles and Frasier fail dismally in their bid to get tickets for a popular new theatre production, while Daphne achieves the dubious distinction of having a photograph of her bottom appear in a Seattle newspaper

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Martin decides to set Frasier up with Duke's beautiful daughter Marie, but it soon becomes clear she is only interested in him because she needs a psychiatrist and does not want to pay for one. Guest starring Teri Hatcher

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Maris tries to woo Niles with anonymous presents, but Frasier thinks the gifts were intended for him and risks his latest relationship to learn the identity of his secret admirer. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: In Vermont, can Frank and Mike strike a deal on an elephant, an alligator and... Elvis? And a rusted-out trailer in New York leads to a treasure trove of folk art and rare military memorabilia.

programme.title: Renovation Nation
programme.desc: In Cheshire, Matt and Charlotte's Georgian home shows worrying signs of decay. In Cumbria, Graham and Jodie find a secret room, while in Cornwall, Sophie and Colin try to fit their dining room reno into lunchbreaks and weekends

programme.title: Escape to Florida
programme.desc: The Best of British pub prepares for St George's Day, complete with a classic red London bus. Teenager Billy chases his football dream in St Pete Beach, while in Tampa, estate agent Justine has luxury flats to sell and a sunset cruise to plan

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with the Rev Kate Bottley in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against words and numbers

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Sisters Pamela and Sheila look for their dream holiday home near Oliva on Spain's Costa de Valencia. They always dreamed of buying a holiday home with their late mother, who was originally from Spain, but unfortunately, she died before they had the chance. In her memory, they're looking for a three or four-bedroom town house with traditional Spanish features for their budget of £70,000. Danni Menzies lines up five impressive properties to show them, which hopefully fulfil their needs

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programme.desc: George tries to find out why his one-euro Sicilian townhouse was abandoned. Mike struggles to bring power to his ancient settlement in northern Spain. And in France, Paul and Yip try to cope with a heartbreaking loss

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Visit three this week is to The Queen's Head Inn in Northamptonshire, where B&B novices Simon and Harriet think their old-school village pub will be a hit but the bacon gets a bashing at breakfast

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Hairdresser Steph attempts to win over her guests with an evening of Spanish food. Will she be a cut above the rest, or will she be saying adios to the thousand pounds?

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Globetrotters Sarah and Neil left their corporate jobs three years ago to travel the world blogging their adventures. They've now decided that they need a pitstop to recuperate between destinations and are hoping to buy a bolthole in Ciudad Quesada on Spain's southern Costa Blanca. With a budget of £120k, Lee Juggurnauth lines up five great options for the couple

programme.title: Channel 4 News

programme.desc: In the first of two special programmes originally shown to celebrate the centenary of Dylan Thomas's birth, Derek Brockway strolls around the poet's home town of Swansea. Accompanied by actor Adrian Metcalfe, Derek sets off from Dylan's childhood home on Cwmdonkin Drive and walks through the city's parks and down to the seafront, before visiting some of the writer's haunts in later life. He then heads west to the Llansteffan peninsula where his guide, artist Osi Rhys Osmond, leads him through the countryside that was home to many of Dylan's relatives. They include his aunt's farm, which would provide the inspiration for the poem Fernhill

programme.title: The Normans

Southern Italy and Sicily were conquered and a prosperous kingdom flourished on the island, which became an important centre of medieval culture and an example of harmony between religions. However, Pope Urban II's call for holy war against the Muslims, to win Jerusalem back, led to the Normans embarking on the First Crusade

Jeff Towns, chairman of the Dylan Thomas Society, joins Derek to explain how Thomas was inspired to write some of his greatest work during this era. programme.desc: Dallas Campbell, Professor Danielle George and Dr Hugh Hunt mark the 80th anniversary of Britain's very first TV broadcast by trying to recreate the landmark event. The inaugural programme came live from Alexandria Palace on November 2, 1936, but there are no surviving recordings of the show. In response, the presenter trio set out to recreate every aspect of this first broadcast, from the variety acts featured right down to the camera equipment used, using authentic technology and filming techniques. Plus, pioneering TV engineer John Logie Baird's assistant - now aged 104 - is on hand to lend some technical assistance, and Dallas meets one of the performers who appeared on the first programme to find out what it is like to be part of TV history

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy will support us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.
