programme.desc:
Today, Andrew Denly and wife Sheila from Sussex are hoping clockmaker Steve Fletcher can fix a vintage boy's toy with big memories attached. It's an antique toy cannon handed down to Andrew by his grandfather, who bought it with his pocket money in 1907. Andrew fondly describes his grandfather as his inspiration and boyhood hero. The little cannon is much treasured but hasn't worked in over 50 years. Steve must use all his ingenuity to get it firing once more.
A Victorian oddity is brought to the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. Sisters Pam and Frances are hoping Suzie can revive a novelty inkwell in the shape of a hat. It is a treasured family heirloom as it had huge sentimental value to the sisters' mother. After years of vigorous overuse, the button mechanism no longer works and it is missing its leather covering. Suzie drafts in sibling Steve Fletcher to help make a missing part, and she discovers a new talent for miniature millinery as she returns the inkwell to its stylish former glory.
Finally, ceramics expert Kirstin Ramsey prays for divine intervention as she tries to rebuild a saintly statue. Caroline Morson and Professor John Northover have come to the barn seeking help resurrecting an important icon that's been a symbol of hope to many: a statue of St Fiacre, the patron saint of gardeners and haemorrhoid victims! The statue has been a landmark in the garden of St Mark's Hospital, a centre for the treatment of bowel disease, for many years, but has been vandalised and is now broken in two. Gifted to the hospital by Caroline's father, renowned pathologist Dr Basil Morson, staff and patients alike are keen to see St Fiacre restored and back on duty. By far one of the biggest projects Kirsten has had on her bench, she must clean and reunite the two large broken halves, creating an imperceptible join to breathe new life into this old saint.

When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

In the freezing Antarctic, Emperor penguins find their soul mate through their own unique "heart song". Unfortunately for young bird Mumble, he can't sing a note, but he can tap dance brilliantly. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.

But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2

Life changes for Max the dog when his owner has a child, turning Max into something of an overprotective worrier. However, a family trip introduces him to grizzled farm dog Rooster, who helps him overcome his fears. Meanwhile, Max's rabbit pal Snowball angers a tyrannical circus owner, plunging the pet gang into imminent danger.

programme.title: Wonder Park

June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

However, the star guest at the convention is the Grand High Witch, who reveals her dastardly plan to turn the nation's children into rodents.

He is only able to pursue his goal of a mission to space by buying prime genetic material from a "Valid" and forge a new identity. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
programme.desc: Live from Washington DC, Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As polls close and votes pour in across the country, the balance of power in Washington is at stake. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

programme.desc:
The Squirrels are playing hide-and-seek and come across a pink snorting fluffy animal - a Scrufflelump!
The Squirrels are excited and want to keep the Scrufflelump as their pet, but Duggee is wary. Keeping a pet is a lot of work. They need feeding, cleaning, exercising and much more that will keep you very busy. But they are wonderful too and can bring a lot of love to life. Duggee lets the Squirrels know the Clubhouse is not quite ready for another animal, so the Squirrels and Duggee wave Potato goodbye.
Just as the Squirrels are starting to miss Potato, who do they spot? Potato! It's followed them home! The Squirrels take up their responsibilities and feed, wash and exercise Potato, but Duggee was right and minding a pet is very tiring work.
Just then, there's a knock on the Clubhouse door. A family of Scrufflelumps are standing outside. The Squirrels are confused as these Scrufflelumps can speak just like them and not with the incoherent noises that Potato makes.
They ask if the Squirrels have seen their dad. The Squirrels are very confused until Potato coughs and spits and says yes to them. Potato is the Scrufflelump family dad! Potato packs up and leaves, and the Squirrels learn a valuable lesson about how to take care of a pet.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Plans for a relaxed evening at Jay's turn out to be anything but when Claire is mad with her dad over his lack of gratitude for her holding the fort at work and Mitchell is busy scheming after receiving a gift he doesn't like. Meanwhile, Phil and Gloria stop off at her old salon and get scissor-happy when a stylist fails to show up

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Leah hopes to reconnect with Imran, unaware of what he's hiding. An allegation shakes Abigail, and a mother tries to get her son to open up

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: As shockwaves ripple through the village, this may be the end of Cindy and Imran's tragic love story. And a phone call leads a resident to make a bold decision

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: Comedy clips showcasing amusing internet videos featuring sheep

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples host dinner parties in Essex, with an eye on the £1,000 prize. The first couple to host are flight attendant Penny and doctors' surgery manager Chris. Their homely menu doesn't quite live up to the standards of bling-loving receptionist Tatia and her husband, metal worker Mick. The youngest duo, Lewis and Krystal, host on day two and manage to impress their older guests. Finally, it's Mick and Tatia's chance to show off their culinary skills with a fancy menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads for Bridgeport, Connecticut, to visit Cafe Tavolini, which is being neglected by husband and wife managers teetering on the edge of divorce. The estranged couple's two children are struggling to save the business from their parents' disputes, and the visiting chef tries to shock the pair into stopping the restaurant from becoming a casualty of their quarrel

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In this revisit episode, chef Gordon Ramsay goes back to Mojito, the Junction (formerly known as Flamangos) and Bazzini to check in with the owners he helped in the past and find out whether his advice has been put to good use. Will he be pleased with their progress?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. Every year profits nosedive through the bleak winter months, and matters aren't improved when it becomes clear they have both lost their passion - not only for the business but also for each other. With the restaurant and marriage on the line, Gordon tries to help turn things around before it's too late

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Gloria panics when Joe is deemed too aggressive for gym class, leading her to worry that he has inherited a family curse, and Cam spins Lily a little white lie about her missing cat, only for it to spiral out of control. Phil taps into a rich new vein of clients - recently divorced women - but are they more trouble than they're worth? American comedy, starring Sofia Vergara, Eric Stonestreet and Ty Burrell

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Cam's older sister is in town but he is scared to share his engagement news with her because she is a sad, lonely singleton. Or so he thinks. Phil and Claire feel guilty when they make a joint decision to skip Luke's volleyball game and Jay tells Gloria she needs reading glasses - but she's not having any of it. The 100th episode of the family sitcom, starring Eric Stonetreet, Ty Burrell, Julie Bowen and Ed O'Neill

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lionel Richie arrives in Springfield to serenade Homer as a reward for saving Mr Burns from drowning in a water fountain. The hapless hero soon gets an appetite for luxury, and hires a life coach to help him achieve his aspirations. Before long, he experiences a terrifying job interview for a copper-tubing firm, and begins to long for his old life at the power plant

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer becomes an opera star when a hospital visit reveals his voice has the power to aid his fellow patients' recoveries. The hapless family man is soon playing to capacity crowds at the Springfield Opera House, but his new fame attracts the attention of an obsessive fan

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer wakes up to find he has lost not only his memory of the previous 24 hours, but also his family - and enlists the help of Professor Frink to discover what has happened. Chief Wiggum then compounds his misery by informing him of a domestic disturbance at his home the previous night

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge is stalked by an escaped convict who is angry with her for breaking a promise to visit him in prison. Meanwhile, Lisa receives an award for Student of the Millennium. With the voice of Steve Buscemi

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly and Murray help Erica move into her college dormitory, where her room-mate is also named Erica, but Beverly has a hard time saying goodbye to her daughter. Now that Lainey has gone to college, Adam tries to find the perfect girlfriend for Barry, even pretending to build one, as in the film Weird Science

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam has to tackle a school project on the Second World War, so decides to make a film featuring his grandfather. However, Pops takes matters into his own hands when Adam finds all his war stories mundane. Erica fails to cope with her own cooking and laundry at college and returns home to confront Beverly for over-mothering her, but Murray insists that Beverly starts to teach Erica and Barry basic life skills

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Part one of two. Mitch and Cam prepare to walk down the aisle, but are faced with a host of hitches before they tie the knot. Pepper is forced to bring the ceremony forward by four hours because of a spreading wildfire, while one of the grooms' tuxedos has been left at the dry cleaners

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Part two of two. With Mitch and Cam's big day beset by one disaster after another, Pepper is forced to find a new venue - only for the couple to be forced out once again. Their only option is to hold the ceremony at home - but then Sal, who supposed to be marrying them, is forced to leave. Will they ever get to say 'I do'? Elizabeth Banks guest stars

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Emmy-winning comedy returns - as do Cameron and Mitchell, who are back from honeymoon and determined to keep the romance alive. Cameron, however, takes it just a little step too far. The Dunphys, meanwhile, have been enjoying a relaxing summer without smart-alec Alex, who is away on a trip - although she threatens to rock the boat after arriving home early - and Gloria shows a different side after arguing with Jay about the lack of effort he puts into his appearance

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay and Gloria celebrate their anniversary, but cannot decide on what kind of gift to give each other. Meanwhile, the Dunphys join Alex on her college tour and Phil, Luke and Haley find themselves in a mirrored waiting room with a button and a sign that says 'Do Not Push'. Comedy, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Grampa evades the security of the retirement home, and Homer and Marge set out to find him. Along the way, they discover intriguing details of his past, such as the time he worked alongside musician Marvin Hamlisch. The Oscar-winning composer guest stars as himself, in a role he recorded shortly before his death

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is surprised to learn that his accountant neighbour Dan works for Fat Tony - and has been asked to take the Mob boss's place while he serves time on a jury. Meanwhile, Lisa decides to add insects to her diet, but is plagued by a series of nightmares. With the voice of Steve Carell

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Another trilogy of spooky stories originally broadcast at Halloween. A Mayan civilisation - with some very familiar-looking members - predicts the end of the world, and a scientific experiment in Springfield ends up lumbering the town with its very own black hole - which threatens to swallow everything and everyone in sight. Finally, a spot of time travel relocates Bart to 1974 for a Back to the Future parody in which he inadvertently jeopardises his parents' relationship

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge experiences mixed emotions when she is forced to replace the family car after an encounter with a sinkhole, while Bart becomes interested in Lisa's extracurricular activities after finding out about her covert meetings in town. With the guest voice of stock car racer Jeff Gordon

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Maddox shares in his brother's excitement as his health progresses, but not everyone feels the same. Sienna overhears a conversation, and a resident faces questions

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will surprises everyone with an apparent attempt to better himself by joining the school poetry club, but he has an ulterior motive. Starring Will Smith

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Part one of two. Will and Carlton get caught up in a battle of egos as they try to find dates for Hilary's Halloween party. Guest starring Quincy Jones and Bo Jackson

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Part two of two. Will and Carlton's competition to secure a date for Hilary's Halloween party escalates when both of them try to win over Melinda. The pair find themselves making up stories about each other

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The fiery chef pulls no punches as he visits struggling restaurants across America and spends one week trying to help them become successful

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their insightful and passionate takes on TV shows including I'm a Celebrity South Africa, Citadel, The 1% Club, Celebrity Hunted, Britain's Got Talent, Reunion Hotel, and Canal Boat Diaries. First shown in May 2023

programme.title: The Traitors Ireland
programme.desc: Siobhán McSweeney hosts as the ultimate game of backstabbing and mystery continues at Slane Castle

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Wisdom of the Crowd
programme.desc: Quiz show, hosted by John Bishop, in which contestants take on the collective knowledge of the studio audience in a bid to win big cash prizes

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: A round-up of national and international news, plus current affairs, arts and entertainment, and weather

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Gethin Jones and Helen Skelton present the weekday magazine show featuring a mixture of topical discussion and expert advice for viewers

programme.title: Crimewatch Caught
programme.desc: The search to find two killers - one who spent years plotting revenge against his prison guard and another who killed a veteran, leaving the body in an outbuilding

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Jacqui Joseph is in Norfolk, where she cannot the boiler in a bungalow. The new owner of a Redcar property gives himself an almighty commute to work, while a Grade II listed cottage on the brink of collapse is in need of complete restoration

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Presenter Eric Knowles encounters Daleks, robots and a Tardis in Carmarthenshire, as two teams of Doctor Who fans shop for keenly priced antiques. Companions Richard Madley and Kate Bliss are on hand to offer expert advice in a special edition originally shown in 2023 when the sci-fi show celebrated its 60th anniversary

programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: BBC News at One; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Jacqui Joseph finds a drop-leaf table, a pair of legless dining chairs and a collection of unwanted curtains at High Wycombe recycling centre for her and the team to upcycle

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman helps a globe-trotting couple to find a home in the Oxfordshire countryside, and discovers how the county is leading the way with the recycling of food waste

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers is presented with a tennis racquet used by his grandfather at Wimbledon, a set of antique scales, cinema seats and artwork of demons living inside a tooth

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Friends Sue, Liam, Anne and Lili aim to win big by stepping in the right direction, avoiding the wrong answers and making it across the bridge to the other side. Game show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips

programme.title: BBC News at Six; Weather
programme.desc: The latest headlines

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: Alex Jones and Roman Kemp present another mix of nationwide reports and live studio-based chat

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Denise sees out a plan for the sake of her family, Linda worries about her children, and Ian helps out a friend

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti launch the search the next culinary star with a series of demanding challenges designed to test their skills to the limit. The first six chefs to enter the kitchen begin by taking on a skills test in which they pair up to recreate a crab raviolo dish, served with a rich, deeply flavoured bisque. Then they serve up a signature dish - knowing one of them will soon be hanging up their apron

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Life is in the balance after the explosion at Katie's house, while Gerry's evidence on state collusion is released. The section race to put an end to Morgan's empire. Belfast police drama, starring Siân Brooke, Andi Osho, Cathy Tyson and Tabitha Smyth

programme.title: BBC News at Ten
programme.desc: A round-up of today's headlines

programme.title: Tall Tales & Murder
programme.desc: Drama series, starring Aidan Gillen. A patient wakes from a coma at a Dublin nursing home and reveals he's a gangster with a hoard of buried Celtic treasure. This presents a once in a lifetime opportunity for unconventional nurse Bridget and ex con Paul

programme.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
programme.desc: Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry present live from Washington, DC, to guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As votes pour in across the country, BBC News broadcast through the night, bringing viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls

programme.title: The Nature of Love
programme.desc: Sophia's comfortable life turns upside down the day she meets Sylvain, and she leaves everything for a new, burning passion. Romantic comedy, starring Magalie Lepine Blondeau, Pierre-Yves Cardinal, Francis-William Rheaume and Monia Chokri. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: It's All About Love
programme.desc: Sci-fi love story starring Joaquin Phoenix and Claire Danes. John and his wife Elena, a world famous ice-skater, have lived apart for several years. Finally deciding to end their marriage, John pays a flying visit to New York to get Elena to sign their divorce papers. But when she fails to turn up, he begins to suspect her celebrity lifestyle is not what it seems. As strange and unexpected events start to unfold, John realises that Elena actually needs him more than ever before.

programme.title: Gun Fury
programme.desc: Western starring Rock Hudson and Donna Reed. When his fiancée Jennifer is kidnapped by outlaw Frank Slayton, rancher Ben Warren sets out on their trail with Slayton's embittered ex-partner.

programme.title: The Admirable Crichton
programme.desc: Comedy adventure based on the play by JM Barrie, starring Kenneth More. A butler finds that his common-sense values give him the upper hand over his aristocratic employer when they are marooned on a tropical island.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Gene Tierney as a widow who befriends the mischievous ghost of a sea captain (Rex Harrison) when she moves into the isolated coastal house where he used to live.

programme.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Wagner and Jeffrey Hunter. Infamous outlaw Jesse James and his gang are cornered in a swamp following a failed bank raid. As James prepares to shoot his way to freedom, the story of his life of violence and crime is told by his family and loved ones.

programme.title: A Knight's Tale
programme.desc: Romantic period adventure starring Heath Ledger. In 14th-century Europe, William, a young commoner, poses as Sir Ulric of Liechtenstein, a knight. But can he change his lowly destiny by winning jousting tournaments, or will the evil Count Adhemar discover the deception before William can win the fair Lady Jocelyn's hand?

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Woody Harrelson and Andy Serkis. In the third instalment of the rebooted franchise, ape leader Caesar embarks on a quest for revenge after the crazed Colonel McCullough kills Caesar's family in a bid to assassinate him.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: A chef-turned-reclusive-truffle hunter who lives alone in the Oregonian wilderness must return to his past in Portland in search of his beloved foraging pig after she is kidnapped. First-time director Michael Sarnoski's drama, starring Nicolas Cage, Alex Wolff and Adam Arkin

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: The award-winning celebrity challenge comes to the Channel 4 network, with Greg Davies as the all-powerful Taskmaster and Alex Horne (the show's creator) as his sidekick, setting all manner of perplexing and downright extraordinary tasks for five contestants from the comedy world - Johnny Vegas, Katherine Parkinson, Daisy May Cooper, Mawaan Rizwan and Richard Herring. programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown: New Year Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with a Hogmanay flavour. Jon Richardson and Richard Osman take on Johnny Vegas and Sara Pascoe. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Today, Andrew Denly and wife Sheila from Sussex are hoping clockmaker Steve Fletcher can fix a vintage boy's toy with big memories attached. It's an antique toy cannon handed down to Andrew by his grandfather, who bought it with his pocket money in 1907. Andrew fondly describes his grandfather as his inspiration and boyhood hero. The little cannon is much treasured but hasn't worked in over 50 years. Steve must use all his ingenuity to get it firing once more.
A Victorian oddity is brought to the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. Sisters Pam and Frances are hoping Suzie can revive a novelty inkwell in the shape of a hat. It is a treasured family heirloom as it had huge sentimental value to the sisters' mother. After years of vigorous overuse, the button mechanism no longer works and it is missing its leather covering. Suzie drafts in sibling Steve Fletcher to help make a missing part, and she discovers a new talent for miniature millinery as she returns the inkwell to its stylish former glory.
Finally, ceramics expert Kirstin Ramsey prays for divine intervention as she tries to rebuild a saintly statue. Caroline Morson and Professor John Northover have come to the barn seeking help resurrecting an important icon that's been a symbol of hope to many: a statue of St Fiacre, the patron saint of gardeners and haemorrhoid victims! The statue has been a landmark in the garden of St Mark's Hospital, a centre for the treatment of bowel disease, for many years, but has been vandalised and is now broken in two. Gifted to the hospital by Caroline's father, renowned pathologist Dr Basil Morson, staff and patients alike are keen to see St Fiacre restored and back on duty. By far one of the biggest projects Kirsten has had on her bench, she must clean and reunite the two large broken halves, creating an imperceptible join to breathe new life into this old saint.

programme.title: Social Media Monsters
programme.desc: When Carson Sistrunk set off to meet a woman he knew off Snapchat, he told his parents he'd be back that night. A day later, Carson was missing and so was his truck. Sierra Inscoe was caught driving Carson's vehicle, but there was no sign of Carson. Soon, his body was discovered near an oil well, and Inscoe became the prime suspect. As police dug into her social media profiles, a disturbing pattern of deception and crime emerged

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Fiery chef Gordon Ramsay comes to the aid of a mother-and-son team who have gone through 20 chefs in two years at their struggling Italian restaurant in California. The adjoining bar is a triumph, but the oldest dining establishment in town needs an overhaul if the inexperienced owners are to make a profit

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Southbridge, Massachusetts, where he checks into the Vienna Inn, an Austrian-themed hotels and restaurant. Owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach have seen their cluttered inn acquire a negative reputation among the locals, and as a result, business isn't what it used to be. Can Gordon turn things round and keep the doors to this historic hotel open?

programme.title: Tempting Fortune
programme.desc: The revellers return to camp and reveal the staggering cost of their night of luxury, leaving the other contestants reeling. The prize pot then suffers another blow when one contestant calls time on the adventure, while the group members are offered the chance to speak to loved ones back home. But as usual, it comes at a price. Rob Beckett presents the jungle adventure

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer head to the idyllic Lancashire village of Scorton, where they help Joanne and Nick navigate their seven-year-long stand-off. Their three-bedroom chalet bungalow has been bursting at the seams since the arrival of their two children - and the mountains of toys and chaos they bring. Joanne adores her little home along with the neighbours and sense of community, and dreams of making it work but Nick wants the best for his family and is itching for a bigger house to raise the kids in. They both agree that something has to give. With a £70,000 Love It budget, Kirstie devises a brilliant plan to transform this compact property into a family-friendly home but with such a limited footprint and additional family needs to consider, will her efforts be enough? Meanwhile, Phil faces a challenge with his £550,000 List It budget as he tries to convince Joanne with some jaw-dropping houses that give them some desperately needed space. While Joanne is impressed, can she be persuaded to leave the neighbourhood that she loves? And can Kirstie and Phil reunite this couple and ensure they make the best decision for their future?

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Married couple Dexter and Aaron are looking for a fluffy, chunky dog. Ellie the chihuahua will have to prove that being neither fluffy or chunky isn't a problem when it comes to being their perfect match. Yoga teacher Venessa and son Jacob try to assess whether there is a bond between them and Zoe, a friendly beagle who has been trying to sniff out a new home for a while. Plus, Stanley the anxious Staffie meets 'dog-mad' pair Linda and Richard

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam finally asks Diane to marry him, but she rejects his proposal - making him so angry that he chases her out of the bar and ends up in court charged with assault and battery. Ted Danson and Shelley Long star

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Diane decide to get married, but have very different ideas over what sort of engagement ring to buy. Comedy, starring Ted Danson and Shelley Long

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug loses his driving licence when he tries to help famous sportswriter Ray Barone with his driving test. Ray Romano and Brad Garrett guest star

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie is forced to cook a Thanksgiving meal for 10 guests from scratch, and Doug meets a long-lost friend he does not even remember

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug and Carrie can't afford the new car they want, so Arthur steps in with a distinctive gift for them

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray tries to ensure Frank's 65th birthday is memorable by buying him an expensive aquarium just like the one he has always admired in a local Chinese restaurant. Unfortunately, one of the fish dies, sinking the Barone household into gloom and discord

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray reluctantly attends a high-school reunion with Debra, only to discover she had been friends with the in-crowd who made his nerdy teenage years a living hell. Comedy, starring Ray Romano and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra decides to write a letter to Marie to tell her to stop interfering after ruining her Tupperware party, but a shocked Ray tries to intercept the note

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles moves in with Frasier after his divorce leaves him strapped for cash

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles and Frasier prepare for a dinner party at Maris's beach house, but a bizarre turn of events results in them having to devote all their time to disposing of a dead seal that has washed up on the shore

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Unemployed Roz is reduced to borrowing money from Frasier, but he thinks she is spending it irresponsibly. Meanwhile, rumours circulate that KACL is rehiring staff. Comedy, starring Peri Gilpin and Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: A friendly woman comes to Frasier's rescue when he's out Christmas shopping. He offers to return the favour, but the last thing he expects is to end up on a blind date with her daughter - while pretending to be Jewish. Meanwhile, Niles takes part in a festive pageant

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: In Colorado, Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz try to negotiate with a collector who demands a high price for every item up for sale. Down the road, an artist has a killer collection of atomic age lamps and pricey glow-in-the-dark sculptures. Plus, a lone mountain home features its own jailhouse, an underground bomb shelter and an awesome collection of Western ware

programme.title: Renovation Nation
programme.desc: It's all hands on deck as Matthew and Michelle can finally move into their Welsh farmhouse. In Cornwall, Sophie and Colin discover exciting original features in their listed townhouse. And in Cumbria, Graham and Jodie take their mansion renovation to new heights

programme.title: Escape to Florida
programme.desc: Irish dance teacher Sarah has the busiest day of her school year - St Patrick's Day - as she shows off her students' talents all over town, including at the very bar where she met her husband, Scott. Can she combine a hectic dance routine with her own wedding celebration? It's a busy day for Kay Rawlins too, as she counts down to kick-off in her job as founder of one of the biggest soccer clubs in the USA. But she hasn't forgotten her roots in Stoke. Donna and Dan pay a surprise visit to their teenage son Oliver as he works poolside in his summer job at one of the most famous hotels in Florida - the Don CeSar - where his parents spent their first holiday together over 30 years ago

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with the Rev Kate Bottley in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against words and numbers

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Lee Juggurnauth uses all of his property expertise to find Robert and Thomas their perfect holiday home in and around La Mata in south east Spain. The couple have been visiting Spain for years, and see this as the first stepping stone to a permanent move there. They have a maximum budget of £82,000 to play with

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programme.desc: Mike takes living conditions back to basics at a 200-year-old mountain village in Spain, while in France Paul and Yip balance the demands of multiple unstable structures in their hamlet. Over in Sicily, George aims to expand his one-euro property empire

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: At Worlington Hall in Suffolk, married couple Louis and Michael lay on luxurious interiors and take their guests for a 'mill around a mill'. Breakfast is an opulent affair and the B&Bers are left hailing their hosts. However, one pair are perturbed by Louis and Michael's lavish approach

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The penultimate host in and around Liverpool is coffee shop worker Lisa, who intends to treat her guests to the exotic flavours of Mexico. Even though she's never been there, her theory is that everyone likes chilli con carne. Chris doesn't disappoint with his choice of outfit and rocks up dressed as Pablo Escobar, the Columbian gangster. David and Steph discover that Lisa has a 'ladyship' title, while Sarah is confused by the margarita cheesecake thinking it'll be based on the pizza. There's more embarrassment for Sarah when she tells the group she thought Chris was dressed as Steph the previous night

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Alison wants to fulfil her lifelong dream of moving to France and has decided that Sarlat in the stunning Dordogne region of France is the perfect place for her. Peppered with beautiful towns brimming with medieval and renaissance architecture and the quintessential French ambience, there are plenty of places to enjoy the local cuisine and culture. With Alison's aunt Mandy helping with the search, Jean Johansson lines up five fantastic properties for Alison's budget of up to £300,000, from light-filled, open-plan opulence and a charming chateau-style maison to a house that certainly made a splash

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: Part two of two. In September 1972, one month after Idi Amin announces his plan to expel all Ugandan Asians from the country, 80,000 people are making plans to flee, in fear for their lives. In the UK, controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. Amin refuses to negotiate, stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country

programme.title: The Book That Changed My Life
programme.desc: Inspired by her passion to get people reading, Queen Camilla joins four remarkable people to share the stories of books that shaped them. Warm, emotional and full of hope, the programme shows how reading can lift people up, open minds and even change lives in a celebration of the power inside every book

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Brittany with her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin , heading to the vast oyster beds of Cancale, with the region still supplying half of France with the seafood. Brittany also boasts plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers and Simon Bower relax into a pair of comfy club chairs. Jane has a personal connection to a curious piece of furniture, and one item has the dealers playing house

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part, while Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost updates on his garden as the growing season ends, and in the Peak District, Rekha Mistry advises on vegetables. Rachel de Thame celebrates chrysanthemums in Nottinghamshire, a mother and daughter discuss Japanese maples, and Advolly Richmond explores Blenheim Palace's garden history

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food festival at Llangollen, where local food experts reveal their passion for their produce. Farmer Jim Smith tests his tastebuds with some hot sauces in Edinburgh, chef Suzie Lee discovers the key to producing cider in Armagh, and the secrets behind making a homemade pie on a budget are revealed

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Leuchars, known nowadays on the railways as Leuchars for St Andrews, which is Scotland's oldest university.

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium
programme.desc: The Princess of Wales makes a surprise visit, there is concern for a new arrival, and Florence the shark takes a pregnancy test

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team examine the public's treasures brought for their scrutiny to Lampeter in Ceredigion. Objects valued include a bust of celebrated Welsh writer Dylan Thomas, an early book of silhouettes and a plate bought by its owner for a mere £5 that turns out to be worth £10,000. Originally shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Blackburn Cathedral, Charles Hanson values a rare Eureka clock and Anita Manning is drawn to four oil paintings of the Ribble Valley. Host Paul Martin meets up with Michelin-star chef Nigel Haworth to discover how to make the perfect Lancashire hotpot

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take part in the penultimate round of challenges. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is joined by more couples to dish up all the action from the world of Strictly Come Dancing. Plus, costume designer Vicky Gill reveals some of the weekend's outfits

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson is in the Welsh Borders, showcasing some tempting houses to a retired couple who have a whopping £1 million to spend. Along with a characterful property, they're after somewhere with holiday-let potential or space for a glamping business. Jules is also in his element when he meets experts in traditional construction methods who are keeping heritage building skills alive

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across one of the widest parts of Britain, from the western Atlantic coast in Wales through the hilly Midlands and down to the low-lying eastern coast of Norfolk, which has some of the lowest rainfall in the country. Here, Monty visits places that have influenced how people garden - small, deeply loved spaces, and gardens that bankrupted their owners - and sees how intensely personal British gardens can be and how they reflect some of the greatest passions as well as some real eccentricities

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Documentary charting the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal. This first helping explores how Marco challenged French-dominated kitchens in the 1980s, transforming British gastronomy, setting standards for Gordon and Heston. Contributors include Marcus Wareing, Michel Roux Jr, Angela Hartnett, Clare Smyth and Tom Kerridge

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig looks at extra-large and extra-small topics, with Desiree Burch, Gyles Brandreth, Sheila Hancock and Alan Davies

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: When Sharks Attack
programme.desc: Los Angeles is rocked by four shark attacks in just four months. Experts search for clues to find out if there might be more shark attacks ahead

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Baggage Manager Kevin has a rough day trouble-shooting a number of mechanical breakdowns, while security screening discovers a passenger travelling with a gun

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Oakley heads to the Kroschel Wildlife Center to treat a moose with limb issues and a mink that can't stop sneezing. Next, a rescued lovebird has become gravely ill after compulsively laying eggs, and the team will do everything they can to try and save her. Finally, Dr. Oakley treats a 16-year-old dog with a mass and takes part in releasing moose calves back into the wild.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: The ZooTampa Team has their hands full with critical manatees, a young Nyala undergoes a messy procedure, and a nervous cockatoo needs a beak trim

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: The Hollywood star explores some of the world's most extreme environments

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: The Hollywood star explores some of the world's most extreme environments

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned Cold War era Russian military base. Plus, a stone structure is found on the sea floor near Yonaguni Island, and a palatial mansion is found on Isla Grande

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Bjoern is put under pressure when a head-on collision between two trucks blocks an ambulance on an emergency call-out. Thord works through the night to rescue a driver trapped in his jack-knifed truck and get his valuable cargo to the airport in time. In the north, Stig oversees the rescue of a 30-ton truck that's smashed through the safety rail, dangerously close to an electricity pylon.

programme.title: Alaska's Grizzly Gauntlet
programme.desc: For many years, it's been the home to the Inupiat people, and Polar Bears. With the advent of climate change, the bears are spending more time on the island while they wait for the ice to arrive. In this dramatically changing environment, they must adapt to survive and Les investigates how they're doing this and what the future brings for these formidable predators.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.
